cli.build_arguments.reason: Build accepts one optional project and one target: bun, native (also rust), or wasm. The default Bun target requires a project.
cli.build_arguments.recommendedNextStep: Use `jadpo build <project>` or `jadpo build --target native|wasm` in the experiment checkout

cli.build_experiment_scope.reason: The native and WASM adapters are qualified only for the local conformance and auth-policy fixtures; general project compilation is not enabled.
cli.build_experiment_scope.recommendedNextStep: Run `jadpo build --target native|wasm` from the repository checkout to build the fixture
cli.build_experiment_scope.summary: Experimental target only builds qualified fixtures

cli.build_experiment_unavailable.reason: The experimental build needs the checked-in generator, fixture, and adapter sources; they are not bundled into the installed CLI.
cli.build_experiment_unavailable.recommendedNextStep: Run this build from the Jadpo repository checkout
cli.build_experiment_unavailable.summary: Shared-Rust experiment checkout was not found

cli.build_tool_failed.reason: The local build tool could not start or exited unsuccessfully; no successful build is claimed.
cli.build_tool_failed.recommendedNextStep: Inspect the build output and the prerequisites in experiments/native-conformance/README.md

cli.check_arguments.reason: `check` accepts one project path plus the optional supported diagnostic presentation flags.
cli.check_arguments.recommendedNextStep: Use `jadpo check <project>` with any presentation flags

cli.config_arguments.reason: `config` accepts `set <field>` or `check` from inside the current project.
cli.config_arguments.recommendedNextStep: Use `jadpo config set <field>` or `jadpo config check`

cli.config_prompt_failed.reason: Jadpo could not read the terminal value or safely control terminal echo.
cli.config_prompt_failed.recommendedNextStep: Restore terminal access and run the command again

cli.config_tty_required.reason: Secret-safe prompting cannot read from a pipe, command argument, or captured agent stream.
cli.config_tty_required.recommendedNextStep: Run the command yourself in an interactive terminal
cli.config_tty_required.summary: Configuration entry requires an interactive terminal

cli.dev_arguments.reason: `dev` accepts one project path and an optional JSON diagnostic format; other positional arguments are not defined.

cli.dev_bun_start_failed.reason: The dev command built the target but could not launch `bun --no-install`, so no runtime process is available.
cli.dev_bun_start_failed.recommendedNextStep: Confirm Bun is installed and executable, then run dev again
cli.dev_bun_start_failed.summary: Bun could not start the generated runtime

cli.dev_port_invalid.reason: The `PORT` environment value must be an integer from 1 through 65535 before the generated runtime can bind it.
cli.dev_port_invalid.recommendedNextStep: Set `PORT` to an available non-zero TCP port

cli.dev_readiness_timeout.reason: The runtime process stayed alive but its local `/health` endpoint did not report readiness within the bounded startup window.
cli.dev_readiness_timeout.recommendedNextStep: Inspect the runtime startup output and verify the configured port is available
cli.dev_readiness_timeout.summary: Generated runtime did not become ready

cli.dev_rollback_cleanup_failed.reason: The replacement runtime became ready, but its temporary last-known-good artifact backup could not be removed.
cli.dev_rollback_cleanup_failed.recommendedNextStep: Remove the reported `.jadpo-runtime-backup` directory after confirming the ready runtime is healthy
cli.dev_rollback_cleanup_failed.summary: Previous runtime revision could not be cleaned up

cli.dev_rollback_prepare_failed.reason: The dev supervisor could not move the current checked build aside before compiling a replacement, so it refused to risk losing rollback continuity.
cli.dev_rollback_prepare_failed.recommendedNextStep: Restore project-directory write access and let dev retry the edit
cli.dev_rollback_prepare_failed.summary: Last-known-good runtime revision could not be preserved

cli.dev_rollback_restore_failed.reason: A replacement runtime failed readiness and the dev supervisor could not atomically restore the preserved checked build.
cli.dev_rollback_restore_failed.recommendedNextStep: Stop dev, restore the `.jadpo-runtime-backup` directory as `build`, and restart the session
cli.dev_rollback_restore_failed.summary: Last-known-good runtime revision could not be restored

cli.dev_runtime_exited.reason: The dev supervisor observed the Bun process terminate before or after readiness, so it can no longer serve the checked build.
cli.dev_runtime_exited.recommendedNextStep: Inspect the runtime output, correct the reported fault, and let dev rebuild

cli.dev_runtime_status_failed.reason: The dev supervisor could not determine whether the child runtime was still running, so it cannot safely report readiness.
cli.dev_runtime_status_failed.recommendedNextStep: Stop the dev session and start a fresh runtime process
cli.dev_runtime_status_failed.summary: Generated runtime status could not be read

cli.dev_target_missing.reason: The dev command could not resolve `build/target/app.ts`, so there is no checked artifact to execute.
cli.dev_target_missing.recommendedNextStep: Run a successful build for the project and start dev again

cli.fmt_arguments.reason: `fmt` accepts one project path and only the optional `--check` mode.

cli.incident_arguments.reason: Local enrichment requires exactly the checked project and one secret-safe runtime event JSON file.

cli.incident_invalid.reason: The file must be a bounded `operational_log_event` with a supported runtime classification, semantic operation identifier, and generated request identifier.
cli.incident_invalid.recommendedNextStep: Provide an unchanged secret-safe event emitted by the generated runtime
cli.incident_invalid.summary: Runtime event is not a valid enrichment input

cli.incident_manifest_invalid.reason: Incident enrichment cannot safely map an operation to source when `build/app.meta.json` is malformed.
cli.incident_manifest_invalid.recommendedNextStep: Rebuild the exact project revision to regenerate the manifest
cli.incident_manifest_invalid.summary: Local build manifest is not valid JSON

cli.incident_manifest_missing.reason: Incident enrichment needs the checked operation-to-source map from `build/app.meta.json` and never infers source locations from event payloads.
cli.incident_manifest_missing.recommendedNextStep: Run `jadpo build` for the exact source revision before enrichment

cli.incident_manifest_stale.reason: The manifest's checked source revision differs from the project now on disk, so its operation locations are not trustworthy.
cli.incident_manifest_stale.recommendedNextStep: Build the current sources or restore the source revision that produced the event
cli.incident_manifest_stale.summary: Local build manifest does not match current sources

cli.incident_operation_unknown.reason: The event names a semantic operation that the matching local build metadata does not contain.
cli.incident_operation_unknown.recommendedNextStep: Use the manifest and sources from the build that emitted this event
cli.incident_operation_unknown.summary: Runtime operation is absent from the local manifest

cli.incident_read_failed.reason: The incident command could not load the selected local event JSON file.
cli.incident_read_failed.recommendedNextStep: Restore read access and pass the correct event file path
cli.incident_read_failed.summary: Runtime event file could not be read

cli.incident_revision_mismatch.reason: Local enrichment is trustworthy only when the runtime event and compiler graph identify the same checked source revision.
cli.incident_revision_mismatch.recommendedNextStep: Use the checked sources that produced the runtime event
cli.incident_revision_mismatch.summary: Runtime event and local source revisions differ

cli.lsp_arguments.reason: `jadpo lsp` runs over standard input and output and does not accept a project path or positional options.

cli.presentation_arguments.reason: Diagnostic format and colour flags must select one supported presentation without changing the semantic diagnostic payload.
cli.presentation_arguments.recommendedNextStep: Choose one supported diagnostic format and colour mode

cli.project_required.reason: This command needs a Jadpo file or project directory before it can discover, check, or generate sources.
cli.project_required.recommendedNextStep: Provide the project path after the command

cli.schema_command_required.reason: `schema` groups explicit identity, decision, plan, SQL-review, and index operations; it does not perform a default mutation.
cli.schema_command_required.recommendedNextStep: Choose a supported `jadpo schema` subcommand and project

cli.schema_decision_arguments.reason: Decision templates and validation require the current project, an `--against` snapshot, and the appropriate output or decisions file.
cli.schema_decision_arguments.recommendedNextStep: Use the documented `schema decision-template` or `schema decision-check` form
cli.schema_decision_arguments.summary: Schema decision command has invalid arguments

cli.schema_diff_arguments.reason: A schema diff compares the current project against one explicit immutable snapshot.
cli.schema_diff_arguments.summary: Schema diff command has invalid arguments

cli.schema_index_accept_arguments.reason: The checked edit must identify one current recommendation by its `Entity.field` path.
cli.schema_index_accept_arguments.summary: Index acceptance requires a recommendation path

cli.schema_plan_arguments.reason: A migration plan requires an earlier snapshot, reviewed decisions, an explicit adapter, and an output file.
cli.schema_plan_arguments.summary: Schema plan command has invalid arguments

cli.schema_rename_arguments.reason: Identity-preserving rename requires a kind plus exact old and new semantic paths.
cli.schema_rename_arguments.summary: Schema rename command has invalid arguments

cli.schema_snapshot_arguments.reason: The immutable identity snapshot is written only to an explicit destination and never overwrites the registry implicitly.
cli.schema_snapshot_arguments.summary: Schema snapshot command requires an output path

cli.schema_sql_arguments.reason: A SQL review requires an earlier snapshot, reviewed decisions, an explicit adapter, and an output file.
cli.schema_sql_arguments.summary: Schema SQL command has invalid arguments

cli.signal_handler_failed.reason: The watch or dev command cannot guarantee structured interruption and child-process cleanup without the platform signal handler.
cli.signal_handler_failed.recommendedNextStep: Stop any existing watcher in this process and start a fresh watch or dev command
cli.signal_handler_failed.summary: Shutdown handler could not be installed

cli.unknown_command.reason: The first argument does not name a supported top-level Jadpo operation.
cli.unknown_command.recommendedNextStep: Run `jadpo help` and choose a listed command

cli.unknown_schema_command.reason: The selected name is not one of the explicit schema identity, decision, planning, SQL-review, or index operations.
cli.unknown_schema_command.recommendedNextStep: Run `jadpo help` and choose a supported schema subcommand

cli.watch_arguments.reason: `watch` accepts one project path and an optional JSON diagnostic format; other positional arguments are not defined.

cli.watch_input_read_failed.reason: The watcher could not enumerate the project or read a tracked source while creating a stable change snapshot.
cli.watch_input_read_failed.recommendedNextStep: Restore project read access; watching will retry on the next change
cli.watch_input_read_failed.summary: Watched project inputs could not be read

cli.watch_output_failed.reason: The watcher could not send its human or JSON event to the output stream, so consumers may have an incomplete revision sequence.
cli.watch_output_failed.recommendedNextStep: Restart the watch process with a writable output stream
cli.watch_output_failed.summary: Watch lifecycle event could not be written

configuration.binding_empty.reason: An empty binding cannot identify a local or deployment environment value.
configuration.binding_empty.recommendedNextStep: Use a non-empty stable environment binding name

configuration.binding_invalid.reason: Bindings use portable environment identifiers beginning with a letter or underscore and containing only letters, digits, and underscores.
configuration.binding_invalid.recommendedNextStep: Replace the binding with a portable environment name
configuration.binding_invalid.summary: Configuration binding is not a valid environment name

configuration.binding_required.reason: Every field needs one explicit stable environment binding beside its type.
configuration.binding_required.summary: Configuration field has no deployment binding

configuration.default_invalid.reason: Defaults pass the same nominal constraints as values supplied at startup.
configuration.default_invalid.recommendedNextStep: Change the default so it satisfies the declared constraints
configuration.default_invalid.summary: Configuration default violates its type constraints

configuration.default_literal_required.reason: Source defaults must be deterministic checked literals rather than runtime expressions.
configuration.default_literal_required.recommendedNextStep: Provide a string, number, Boolean, or duration literal

configuration.default_type.reason: The literal representation does not match the field's declared type.
configuration.default_type.recommendedNextStep: Use a literal matching the field type or remove the default
configuration.default_type.summary: Configuration default has the wrong type

configuration.duplicate_binding.reason: A binding must resolve to one typed field so decoding and diagnostics stay unambiguous.
configuration.duplicate_binding.recommendedNextStep: Give each field a distinct binding name
configuration.duplicate_binding.summary: Configuration binding is used by more than one field

configuration.duplicate_option.reason: Each structured configuration option has exactly one value.
configuration.duplicate_option.recommendedNextStep: Keep one occurrence of the option

configuration.expected_field.reason: A configuration body contains structured `name: Type { ... }` fields only.
configuration.expected_field.recommendedNextStep: Add a typed configuration field or remove the invalid item

configuration.field_unknown.reason: Local configuration commands accept the authored field name rather than an arbitrary environment key.
configuration.field_unknown.recommendedNextStep: Use a field declared in the application's configuration block

configuration.fixture_duplicate.reason: A typed test fixture must provide one unambiguous value for each configured field.
configuration.fixture_duplicate.recommendedNextStep: Keep one value for the repeated fixture field
configuration.fixture_duplicate.summary: Fixture supplies a configuration field more than once

configuration.fixture_secret_required.reason: Secret configuration is marked explicitly in fixture source so generated reports and traces can redact it before values enter the harness.
configuration.fixture_secret_required.summary: Secret fixture value must use the secret boundary

configuration.fixture_secret_unexpected.reason: The fixture classification must match the configuration declaration so test behavior cannot change a field's information-flow contract.
configuration.fixture_secret_unexpected.recommendedNextStep: Remove `secret(...)` or classify the declared configuration field as secret
configuration.fixture_secret_unexpected.summary: Ordinary configuration cannot use the secret fixture boundary

configuration.fixture_value_invalid.reason: Harness-provided configuration passes the same nominal validation as deployment configuration before application behavior can read it.
configuration.fixture_value_invalid.recommendedNextStep: Supply a value that satisfies the configured field type
configuration.fixture_value_invalid.summary: Fixture configuration value violates its declared type

configuration.fixture_value_missing.reason: Tests receive configuration only from their typed fixture; every field without a checked source default must be supplied explicitly.
configuration.fixture_value_missing.recommendedNextStep: Add the missing field to the fixture's `config` block

configuration.local_changed.reason: Another process modified `.env.local`, so Jadpo refused to overwrite the newer contents.
configuration.local_changed.recommendedNextStep: Run the configuration command again against the latest file
configuration.local_changed.summary: Local configuration changed during the update

configuration.local_check_failed.reason: At least one declared field is missing or failed validation; no value has been printed.
configuration.local_check_failed.recommendedNextStep: Configure the reported fields and run `jadpo config check` again
configuration.local_check_failed.summary: Local configuration is incomplete or invalid

configuration.local_invalid_encoding.reason: Jadpo preserves `.env.local` structurally and cannot safely update an unknown byte encoding.
configuration.local_invalid_encoding.recommendedNextStep: Convert `.env.local` to UTF-8 without sharing its values
configuration.local_invalid_encoding.summary: Local configuration is not UTF-8 text

configuration.local_read_failed.reason: Jadpo could not safely read `.env.local` from the project directory.
configuration.local_read_failed.recommendedNextStep: Restore project read access and retry
configuration.local_read_failed.summary: Local configuration could not be read

configuration.local_syntax.reason: Jadpo found an invalid or duplicate assignment and refused to guess which value should win.
configuration.local_syntax.recommendedNextStep: Correct the `.env.local` assignment structure and retry

configuration.local_unsafe_target.reason: `.env.local` is a symbolic link or non-file target, so updating it could write outside the project.
configuration.local_unsafe_target.recommendedNextStep: Replace it with a regular project-local file and retry

configuration.local_write_failed.reason: The atomic owner-only `.env.local` update could not be completed.
configuration.local_write_failed.recommendedNextStep: Restore project write access and retry
configuration.local_write_failed.summary: Local configuration could not be saved

configuration.multiple_declarations.reason: One closed configuration declaration owns every application binding.
configuration.multiple_declarations.recommendedNextStep: Combine the fields into one configuration declaration
configuration.multiple_declarations.summary: Application declares configuration more than once

configuration.secret_default.reason: Embedding a secret fallback in authored source would expose it in review and generated artifacts.
configuration.secret_default.recommendedNextStep: Remove the default and supply the secret through the local or deployment environment
configuration.secret_default.summary: Secret configuration cannot have a source default

configuration.secret_flow.reason: Secret-classified values may flow only into compiler-owned declared secret sinks, never ordinary returns, arguments, records, output, or diagnostics.
configuration.secret_flow.recommendedNextStep: Keep the secret inside its generated adapter boundary
configuration.secret_flow.summary: Secret configuration reaches an ordinary value boundary

configuration.type_unsupported.reason: v0.1 configuration supports named scalar types; structured collections and records need a separately designed source contract.
configuration.type_unsupported.recommendedNextStep: Use a supported named scalar type or move the structured data behind an adapter
configuration.type_unsupported.summary: Configuration field type cannot be decoded from one environment value

configuration.unknown_option.reason: A v0.1 configuration field accepts only `binding`, `secret`, and `default` options.
configuration.unknown_option.recommendedNextStep: Correct the option name or remove it

configuration.value_invalid.reason: The supplied value could not be decoded into the field's declared type and constraints.
configuration.value_invalid.recommendedNextStep: Enter a value that satisfies the declared field type

configuration.value_missing.reason: The field has no `.env.local` value and no checked source default, so the service cannot start safely.
configuration.value_missing.recommendedNextStep: Run `jadpo config set <field>` or edit `.env.local` locally

data.atomic_domain_mismatch.reason: One atomic boundary can include only participants that share a compiler-supported transaction and recovery domain.
data.atomic_domain_mismatch.recommendedNextStep: Use one transaction domain or choose an explicit durable workflow
data.atomic_domain_mismatch.summary: Atomic action spans incompatible transaction domains

data.compound_constraint_fields.reason: A compound identity, uniqueness rule, or index joins multiple fields. A rule for one field belongs directly on that field.
data.compound_constraint_fields.recommendedNextStep: Add the other participating fields, or use a field-level modifier
data.compound_constraint_fields.summary: Compound constraint needs at least two fields

data.consistency_invalid.reason: A multi-entity action must select a supported atomic or durable-workflow contract explicitly.

data.consistency_required.reason: Calling mutations owned by more than one entity must not silently widen or split transaction boundaries.
data.consistency_required.summary: Multi-entity action needs an explicit consistency disposition

data.constraint_duplicate_field.reason: Each field can appear once in a compound constraint. Repeating it does not add anything and makes the intended key unclear.
data.constraint_duplicate_field.recommendedNextStep: Remove the repeated field from the constraint

data.constraint_nullable_field.reason: Jadpo does not define cross-adapter uniqueness or identity semantics for null inside compound keys, so constrained fields must be non-nullable.
data.constraint_nullable_field.recommendedNextStep: Use non-nullable fields, or remove the field from the constraint
data.constraint_nullable_field.summary: Compound constraint contains a nullable field

data.constraint_unknown_field.reason: Every member of a compound constraint must resolve to a stored field on the same persisted object.
data.constraint_unknown_field.recommendedNextStep: Correct the field name or add the missing object field
data.constraint_unknown_field.summary: Compound constraint names an unknown field

data.delivery_mode_invalid.reason: A derived store must use durable delivery so an authority change cannot be committed without a replayable update obligation.
data.delivery_mode_invalid.summary: Derived representation delivery mode is not supported

data.duplicate_constraint_shape.reason: Two persistence constraints over the same fields would create duplicate or conflicting database rules.
data.duplicate_constraint_shape.recommendedNextStep: Keep one constraint for this field set
data.duplicate_constraint_shape.summary: Persisted object repeats the same constraint field set

data.entity_not_persistent.reason: Entity identity does not imply storage. Create, query, update, and delete require an explicit persistence capability.
data.entity_not_persistent.recommendedNextStep: Add an accepted persistence capability or remove the storage operation

data.freshness_invalid.reason: Queries must choose one of the accepted authority, read-your-writes, bounded-staleness, or eventual guarantees.
data.freshness_invalid.summary: Query freshness requirement is not recognised

data.identity_field_unknown.reason: An entity reference is derived from one field declared in the same authoritative entity dossier.
data.identity_field_unknown.recommendedNextStep: Correct the identity field name or add the missing field
data.identity_field_unknown.summary: Entity identity names an unknown field

data.identity_nullable.reason: Every stored object needs a present, stable identity. A nullable identity could not address or reference every stored row.
data.identity_nullable.summary: Persisted object identity cannot be nullable

data.inverse_duplicate_name.reason: Fields and inverse relationships share an object member namespace so selection and generated output paths resolve unambiguously.
data.inverse_duplicate_name.recommendedNextStep: Rename the inverse relationship or conflicting field
data.inverse_duplicate_name.summary: Inverse relationship name is already in use

data.inverse_not_owning_reference.reason: An inverse is derived from a stored reference field on the related persisted object; the named `via` field must be that owning reference.
data.inverse_not_owning_reference.recommendedNextStep: Point `via` at the related object's owning reference field
data.inverse_not_owning_reference.summary: Inverse relationship does not target an owning reference

data.inverse_optional_not_unique.reason: An optional one-to-one inverse may return at most one record, so its owning reference must be protected by a unique constraint.
data.inverse_optional_not_unique.recommendedNextStep: Make the owning reference unique, or declare a many-valued inverse
data.inverse_optional_not_unique.summary: Optional inverse relationship is not unique

data.inverse_via_field.reason: The `via` member must resolve to a stored field on the related object before the compiler can derive the reverse relationship.
data.inverse_via_field.recommendedNextStep: Correct the `via` field name on the inverse relationship
data.inverse_via_field.summary: Inverse relationship names an unknown `via` field

data.modifier_non_entity.reason: Identity, uniqueness, indexing, and references describe stored columns and belong in `persist Type { ... }`.
data.modifier_non_entity.recommendedNextStep: Move the setting into the object's `persist` declaration, or remove it
data.modifier_non_entity.summary: Persistence setting requires a persisted object

data.multiple_identities.reason: A persisted object has one identity used by references, stored rows, and generated identifiers.
data.multiple_identities.recommendedNextStep: Keep one identity field or one named identity constraint
data.multiple_identities.summary: Persisted object declares more than one identity

data.mutation_guard_invalid.reason: A value-receiver mutation must establish current authority state by reloading it or checking a revision.

data.mutation_owner_required.reason: Only an action owned by an entity may directly create, update, or delete that entity, so invariants and policy cannot be bypassed.
data.mutation_owner_required.recommendedNextStep: Move the mutation into an action declared by the affected entity
data.mutation_owner_required.summary: Entity mutation is outside its owning action

data.persistence_role_invalid.reason: The initial entity model gives each mutable fact one declared authority; derived stores use cache or projection declarations.

data.persistence_role_required.reason: A stored entity must say which store owns its mutable facts rather than implying multiple writable copies.
data.persistence_role_required.summary: Persistence capability needs an authority role

data.persistence_store_required.reason: The compiler needs a named transaction domain for schema, mutation, and consistency planning.

data.project_role_invalid.reason: Recognised entity, value, query, workflow, and route directories have bounded declaration roles so authority and effects remain reviewable.
data.project_role_invalid.recommendedNextStep: Move the declaration to its recognised role or correct the file contents
data.project_role_invalid.summary: Source file does not match its project role

data.query_freshness_required.reason: The compiler cannot choose a potentially stale representation without knowing the weakest observation contract the caller permits.
data.query_freshness_required.summary: Named query needs a freshness requirement

data.raw_query_outside_named_query.reason: Routes, actions, workflows, jobs, and functions call named queries so every read shape, policy, index, and freshness contract is inventoried.
data.raw_query_outside_named_query.recommendedNextStep: Move the read into a named entity or top-level query
data.raw_query_outside_named_query.summary: Raw query expression is outside a named query

data.receiver_kind_invalid.reason: An entity operation explicitly requires either its stable reference or a complete immutable value snapshot.
data.receiver_kind_invalid.summary: Entity operation receiver is not recognised

data.relationship_cycle.reason: A cycle of required references with cascading deletion has no safe starting point and can recursively delete the same dependency graph.
data.relationship_cycle.recommendedNextStep: Break the cycle by changing one reference or its delete behavior
data.relationship_cycle.summary: Required cascading references form a delete cycle

data.relationship_set_null_required.reason: `set_null` clears the stored reference when its target is deleted, which is impossible for a non-nullable required field.
data.relationship_set_null_required.recommendedNextStep: Make the reference nullable or choose `restrict` or `cascade`
data.relationship_set_null_required.summary: Required reference cannot use `set_null` on delete

data.relationship_target_field.reason: A stored reference must name a field that is actually declared on the target object.
data.relationship_target_field.summary: Reference target field does not exist

data.relationship_target_not_key.reason: A relationship must point to a stable identity or unique field set; otherwise one stored reference could resolve to multiple target records.
data.relationship_target_not_key.recommendedNextStep: Reference the target identity or another unique key
data.relationship_target_not_key.summary: Reference target is not an identity or unique key

data.relationship_type_mismatch.reason: The reference and its target must use the same named type. For example, an `OrderId` cannot point to a `CustomerId` field.
data.relationship_type_mismatch.recommendedNextStep: Use the referenced field's named type for this reference
data.relationship_type_mismatch.summary: Reference field type does not match its target

data.representation_authority_invalid.reason: A cache or projection must derive from the entity's one authority and cannot name that same store as another representation.
data.representation_authority_invalid.recommendedNextStep: Point `from` at the authority and use a distinct derived store
data.representation_authority_invalid.summary: Derived representation has an invalid authority link

data.representation_duplicate.reason: Each cache or projection has one stable identity for delivery, replay, watermarks, and reconciliation.
data.representation_duplicate.recommendedNextStep: Keep one representation with this name or rename it

data.representation_setting_invalid.reason: Cache and projection declarations accept only their bounded store, authority, strategy, and delivery contract settings.
data.representation_setting_invalid.summary: Derived representation setting is not recognised

data.representation_setting_required.reason: A generated projection contract needs its store, authority source, and durable delivery mode to be explicit.
data.representation_setting_required.summary: Derived representation is missing a required setting

data.value_receiver_guard_required.reason: A complete entity value is an immutable observation and cannot overwrite newer authority state without a reload or checked revision.
data.value_receiver_guard_required.summary: Value-receiver mutation needs a stale-write guard

effect.authored_async.reason: Actions may suspend internally, but the compiler derives target-level scheduling without changing the authored callable contract.
effect.authored_async.recommendedNextStep: Remove `async`; declare a function or action with its ordinary Jadpo signature
effect.authored_async.summary: Authored `async` is not part of Jadpo

effect.authored_await.reason: Every ordinary action call completes before the next statement, so the compiler inserts any target-level suspension mechanism internally.
effect.authored_await.recommendedNextStep: Remove `await` and keep the ordinary call expression
effect.authored_await.summary: Authored `await` is not part of Jadpo

effect.function_calls_action.reason: Functions are deterministic and effect-free. Calling an action would allow persistence or other effects to escape through a function boundary.
effect.function_calls_action.recommendedNextStep: Move the call into an action, or call a function instead

effect.function_persistence.reason: Create, query, update, and delete expressions access stored state and are permitted only inside actions; functions remain pure and deterministic.
effect.function_persistence.recommendedNextStep: Move the persistence expression into an action

effect.query_calls_action.reason: Calling an action would let a read-only query perform a mutation or another effect through its call graph.
effect.query_calls_action.recommendedNextStep: Call another query or pure function, or move this orchestration into an action

effect.query_mutation.reason: Named queries are read-only operations. Entity-owned actions are the only declarations allowed to create, update, or delete entity state.
effect.query_mutation.recommendedNextStep: Move the mutation into an action owned by the entity

failure.attempt_required.reason: `attempt` makes it clear that a declared failure may leave the current function or action.
failure.attempt_required.summary: This operation can fail and requires `attempt`

failure.context_field_overlap.reason: The same field cannot be returned to callers and hidden from them at the same time.
failure.context_field_overlap.recommendedNextStep: Choose one disclosure class for the failure context field
failure.context_field_overlap.summary: Failure context field has conflicting disclosure

failure.duplicate_code.reason: Callers use this code to identify a failure, so every public failure code must be unique.
failure.duplicate_code.recommendedNextStep: Give one failure a distinct stable public code
failure.duplicate_code.summary: Failure code is already in use

failure.duplicate_context_field.reason: A rejected failure has one flat context value; assigning a field twice would make its disclosed and internal value ambiguous.
failure.duplicate_context_field.recommendedNextStep: Keep one value for the repeated context field
failure.duplicate_context_field.summary: Failure context field is supplied more than once

failure.duplicate_declaration.reason: Listing the same failure twice does not change what can happen and makes the declaration harder to review.
failure.duplicate_declaration.recommendedNextStep: Remove the repeated failure from the `fails` list

failure.missing_context_field.reason: Every field declared by a failure must be supplied when that failure is rejected so its public and internal values are complete and typed.
failure.missing_context_field.recommendedNextStep: Add the missing field to the `reject` value
failure.missing_context_field.summary: Rejected failure is missing required context

failure.mutation_conflict_not_conflict.reason: A uniqueness or write conflict needs a failure declared with the predefined `Conflict` category.
failure.mutation_conflict_not_conflict.recommendedNextStep: Bind the conflict to a failure declared with `kind: Conflict`

failure.outcome_duplicate_arm.reason: Each declared failure must have exactly one explicit handling decision in an outcome match.
failure.outcome_duplicate_arm.recommendedNextStep: Keep one arm for this failure
failure.outcome_duplicate_arm.summary: Outcome match repeats a failure arm

failure.outcome_infallible.reason: An infallible call has no failure outcome to handle and should be used as an ordinary expression.
failure.outcome_infallible.recommendedNextStep: Remove the outcome match and use the call directly
failure.outcome_infallible.summary: Outcome match requires a fallible call

failure.outcome_missing_arm.reason: Every failure declared by the called function or action needs one explicit recovery, mapping, or propagation arm.
failure.outcome_missing_arm.recommendedNextStep: Add an arm for the missing failure
failure.outcome_missing_arm.summary: Outcome match does not handle every failure

failure.outcome_pattern_invalid.reason: Outcome matches accept only `success(value)` and exact `failure FailureName` patterns.
failure.outcome_pattern_invalid.recommendedNextStep: Replace the pattern with `success(value)` or an exact failure arm
failure.outcome_pattern_invalid.summary: Outcome match arm has an invalid pattern

failure.outcome_subject_required.reason: The compiler needs the called function or action's exact failure surface to check exhaustive outcome arms.
failure.outcome_subject_required.recommendedNextStep: Match a direct fallible function or action call
failure.outcome_subject_required.summary: Outcome match requires one direct call

failure.outcome_success_duplicate.reason: An outcome has one successful value, so exactly one success arm is allowed.
failure.outcome_success_duplicate.summary: Outcome match repeats its success arm

failure.outcome_success_missing.reason: Every outcome match must decide what value to produce when the call succeeds.
failure.outcome_success_missing.summary: Outcome match has no success arm

failure.outcome_success_value_required.reason: The success arm defines the successful value of the whole outcome expression; it cannot reject or propagate.
failure.outcome_success_value_required.recommendedNextStep: Return a compatible value from the success arm
failure.outcome_success_value_required.summary: Success arm must produce a value

failure.outcome_unknown_arm.reason: Failure arms must exactly match the called function or action's declared failure surface.
failure.outcome_unknown_arm.recommendedNextStep: Remove the arm or use a failure declared by the call
failure.outcome_unknown_arm.summary: Outcome arm names a failure the call cannot produce

failure.outcome_wildcard.reason: Exact failure arms force a new decision when a called function or action gains another failure.
failure.outcome_wildcard.recommendedNextStep: Replace the wildcard with one exact arm for each declared failure
failure.outcome_wildcard.summary: Outcome failure wildcard is not allowed

failure.patch_empty_not_invalid_value.reason: A patch with no supplied changes is invalid input, so its failure must use the predefined `InvalidValue` category.
failure.patch_empty_not_invalid_value.recommendedNextStep: Bind `empty:` to a failure declared with `kind: InvalidValue`

failure.required_mutation_not_not_found.reason: When a required update or delete finds no entity, its failure must use the predefined `NotFound` category.
failure.required_mutation_not_not_found.recommendedNextStep: Bind `missing:` to a failure declared with `kind: NotFound`

failure.required_query_not_not_found.reason: When a required query finds no entity, its failure must use the predefined `NotFound` category.
failure.required_query_not_not_found.recommendedNextStep: Bind `missing:` to a failure declared with `kind: NotFound`

failure.stale_declaration.reason: Every failure after `fails` must be able to leave the function or action through a call or `reject`.
failure.stale_declaration.summary: A listed failure can never happen

failure.undeclared_propagation.reason: A function or action must list every failure that can leave its body so callers know what to handle.
failure.undeclared_propagation.recommendedNextStep: Add the failure to `fails`, or handle it before it leaves
failure.undeclared_propagation.summary: A possible failure is missing after `fails`

failure.unknown_context_field.reason: A `reject` value may assign only fields declared by that failure; extra fields have no disclosure classification or generated schema.
failure.unknown_context_field.recommendedNextStep: Remove the extra field or declare it on the failure
failure.unknown_context_field.summary: Rejected failure contains an unknown context field

format.changes_required.reason: The formatter check found source whose canonical Jadpo layout differs from the checked-in text.
format.changes_required.recommendedNextStep: Run `jadpo fmt` and review the resulting source changes
format.changes_required.summary: Source files are not canonically formatted

format.write_failed.reason: The formatter produced canonical text but the source file could not be replaced, commonly because of filesystem permissions or an I/O failure.
format.write_failed.recommendedNextStep: Make the source writable and run the formatter again
format.write_failed.summary: Formatted source could not be written

index.accept_check_failed.reason: After inserting the recommended `index` modifier, the compiler found diagnostics and refused to retain an unchecked source change.
index.accept_check_failed.recommendedNextStep: Review the project diagnostics before accepting the recommendation again
index.accept_check_failed.summary: Index edit did not pass project checks

index.accept_identity_count.reason: Accepting one recommendation must register exactly one new index identity; any other count means the source and identity registry are not changing atomically as expected.
index.accept_identity_count.recommendedNextStep: Restore schema identity consistency and retry the single recommendation
index.accept_identity_count.summary: Index acceptance changed an unexpected number of schema identities

index.accept_range_invalid.reason: The recorded field range does not match the current source text, so inserting `index` could edit the wrong bytes.
index.accept_range_invalid.recommendedNextStep: Re-run the index recommendation command against the current sources
index.accept_range_invalid.summary: Recommended index insertion point is no longer valid

index.accept_registry_missing.reason: The accepted index becomes durable schema identity and cannot be written safely until the project registry has been initialized.
index.accept_registry_missing.recommendedNextStep: Run `jadpo schema init` for this project, then accept the index again
index.accept_registry_missing.summary: Schema identity registry is required before accepting an index

index.accept_rollback_failed.reason: The compiler rejected the edited project but could not restore the original source file, so manual recovery is required before another attempt.
index.accept_rollback_failed.recommendedNextStep: Restore the source from version control and inspect filesystem permissions
index.accept_rollback_failed.summary: Failed index edit could not be rolled back

index.accept_source_read_failed.reason: The recommendation resolved to a source file that became unavailable before the compiler could prepare its checked edit.
index.accept_source_read_failed.recommendedNextStep: Restore read access to the source and re-run the recommendation
index.accept_source_read_failed.summary: Source file for the recommended index could not be read

index.accept_source_write_failed.reason: The compiler prepared the checked `index` insertion but the source file could not be updated.
index.accept_source_write_failed.recommendedNextStep: Make the source writable and accept the recommendation again
index.accept_source_write_failed.summary: Recommended index could not be written to source

index.recommendation_available.reason: Static query analysis found a predicate or ordering field without a matching persistence index; this is advice and does not change source automatically.
index.recommendation_available.recommendedNextStep: Inspect the recommendation and explicitly accept it if the storage trade-off is appropriate
index.recommendation_available.summary: A query field could benefit from an index

index.recommendation_field_missing.reason: The selected recommendation refers to an entity field that is absent from the currently analysed sources.
index.recommendation_field_missing.recommendedNextStep: Re-run index recommendation and choose an item from the current results

index.recommendation_unknown.reason: The requested entity-field recommendation is not present in the latest static query evidence for this project.
index.recommendation_unknown.recommendedNextStep: List current index recommendations and choose one of their identifiers

lsp.content_length_missing.reason: The editor connection sent an LSP frame without the byte length required to read exactly one JSON-RPC message.
lsp.content_length_missing.recommendedNextStep: Restart the editor connection and check the LSP client transport
lsp.content_length_missing.summary: Language-server message has no Content-Length header

lsp.json_invalid.reason: The editor connection delivered a complete frame whose body could not be decoded as a JSON-RPC message.
lsp.json_invalid.recommendedNextStep: Restart the editor connection and inspect the client message payload
lsp.json_invalid.summary: Language-server message is not valid JSON

lsp.json_write_failed.reason: The server produced a response that could not be serialized as JSON for the editor connection.
lsp.json_write_failed.recommendedNextStep: Restart the language server and report the request that triggered this response
lsp.json_write_failed.summary: Language-server response could not be encoded

lsp.read_failed.reason: The editor connection closed or failed while the server was reading an LSP header or message body.
lsp.read_failed.recommendedNextStep: Restart the editor connection; if it recurs, inspect the client transport logs
lsp.read_failed.summary: Language-server input could not be read

lsp.root_missing.reason: The editor did not provide a workspace folder or root URI, so the server cannot discover the Jadpo project and its source files.
lsp.root_missing.recommendedNextStep: Open the Jadpo project folder as an editor workspace and restart the server
lsp.root_missing.summary: Language server has no workspace root

lsp.write_failed.reason: The editor connection closed or failed while the server was sending a framed JSON-RPC response.
lsp.write_failed.recommendedNextStep: Restart the editor connection; if it recurs, inspect the client transport logs
lsp.write_failed.summary: Language-server response could not be written

migration.decision_artifact_exists.reason: Decision templates are immutable review inputs and are never overwritten because doing so could erase authored approval evidence.
migration.decision_artifact_exists.recommendedNextStep: Choose a new output path or review the existing decision file

migration.decision_artifact_invalid.reason: The decision JSON does not match the versioned schema required to bind strategies and evidence to exact schema changes.
migration.decision_artifact_invalid.recommendedNextStep: Regenerate a decision template and transfer reviewed decisions into its schema

migration.decision_artifact_read_failed.reason: The selected reviewed decision artifact was unavailable before validation could bind it to the current change set.
migration.decision_artifact_read_failed.recommendedNextStep: Restore read access and retry with the reviewed decision file
migration.decision_artifact_read_failed.summary: Migration decision file could not be read

migration.decision_artifact_write_failed.reason: The compiler derived the required decisions but could not write the immutable review artifact.
migration.decision_artifact_write_failed.recommendedNextStep: Choose a writable output path and generate the template again
migration.decision_artifact_write_failed.summary: Migration decision template could not be written

migration.decision_change_set_stale.reason: The decision file contains a fingerprint of the exact schema changes it approved. It cannot be reused after those changes differ.
migration.decision_change_set_stale.recommendedNextStep: Regenerate the template and review every decision for the current change set
migration.decision_change_set_stale.summary: Migration decisions refer to a different change set

migration.decision_duplicate.reason: Each identity and change pair must select one strategy so planning has a single reviewed instruction.
migration.decision_duplicate.recommendedNextStep: Keep one decision for this schema change
migration.decision_duplicate.summary: Schema change has more than one migration decision

migration.decision_evidence_duplicate.reason: Each strategy-specific evidence kind has one value; duplicates make the reviewed justification ambiguous.
migration.decision_evidence_duplicate.recommendedNextStep: Keep one value for each required evidence kind
migration.decision_evidence_duplicate.summary: Migration decision repeats an evidence kind

migration.decision_evidence_empty.reason: A required evidence field must contain a meaningful reviewed value rather than an empty or whitespace-only placeholder.

migration.decision_evidence_missing.reason: The selected strategy requires specific evidence before the compiler can record it as an approved migration instruction.
migration.decision_evidence_missing.summary: Migration decision is missing required evidence

migration.decision_evidence_unexpected.reason: The supplied evidence kind is not part of the selected strategy's review contract and cannot broaden that contract implicitly.
migration.decision_evidence_unexpected.recommendedNextStep: Remove the unsupported evidence or choose the matching strategy

migration.decision_missing.reason: This change crosses an approval boundary and cannot be planned until a human selects a strategy and supplies its required evidence.
migration.decision_missing.summary: Schema change has no migration decision

migration.decision_strategy_invalid.reason: Allowed strategies depend on the exact change and disposition; an unrelated strategy cannot be applied by name alone.
migration.decision_strategy_invalid.recommendedNextStep: Choose one of the strategies generated for this schema change
migration.decision_strategy_invalid.summary: Migration strategy is not valid for this change

migration.decision_unexpected.reason: The identity and change pair is not among the decisions required by the bound current change set.
migration.decision_unexpected.recommendedNextStep: Remove the unrelated decision or regenerate the template for the intended change set
migration.decision_unexpected.summary: Decision file contains an unrelated schema change

migration.decision_unresolved.reason: A generated `null` strategy is an explicit review placeholder and cannot authorize planning or SQL generation.
migration.decision_unresolved.summary: Migration decision still needs a strategy

migration.identity_additions_have_remova.reason: The live schema removed or renamed a registered identity; an additions-only command cannot decide that lifecycle change.
migration.identity_additions_have_remova.recommendedNextStep: Resolve renames or reviewed removals before registering additions
migration.identity_additions_have_remova.summary: Schema additions cannot be registered while identities are missing

migration.identity_duplicate_id.reason: One stable identifier cannot belong to multiple schema entries because diffs would no longer track a single object across renames.
migration.identity_duplicate_id.recommendedNextStep: Restore the compiler-owned registry from a valid version or reinitialize before deployment
migration.identity_duplicate_id.summary: Schema registry repeats a stable identity

migration.identity_duplicate_path.reason: Each entity, field, constraint, reference, and index path must map to exactly one stable identity.
migration.identity_duplicate_path.recommendedNextStep: Restore the compiler-owned registry or resolve the duplicate through schema commands
migration.identity_duplicate_path.summary: Schema registry repeats a semantic path

migration.identity_physical_name.reason: Every persistent identity needs a stable physical name so migration SQL can address the same database object after logical renames.
migration.identity_physical_name.recommendedNextStep: Restore a valid compiler-owned registry entry
migration.identity_physical_name.summary: Schema identity has no physical storage name

migration.identity_registry_drift.reason: A persistent identity was added, removed, or renamed outside the explicit schema registry workflow, so intent cannot be inferred safely.
migration.identity_registry_drift.recommendedNextStep: Use the matching schema add or rename command, or restore the source declaration
migration.identity_registry_drift.summary: Schema identities differ from checked source

migration.identity_registry_exists.reason: Initialization never overwrites persistent identities because regeneration could silently assign new identities to deployed objects.
migration.identity_registry_exists.recommendedNextStep: Validate and use the existing registry

migration.identity_registry_invalid.reason: The registry JSON does not match the versioned compiler-owned schema required for stable migration identity.
migration.identity_registry_invalid.recommendedNextStep: Restore the registry from version control or a verified backup

migration.identity_registry_missing.reason: This schema operation requires persistent identities, but the project has not initialized its compiler-owned registry.
migration.identity_registry_missing.recommendedNextStep: Run `jadpo schema init <project>` before this operation

migration.identity_registry_not_canonica.reason: The parsed entries do not serialize to the exact canonical compiler-owned representation, so manual edits cannot be trusted as lifecycle operations.
migration.identity_registry_not_canonica.recommendedNextStep: Restore the canonical file and use schema commands for changes
migration.identity_registry_not_canonica.summary: Schema identity registry was edited outside Jadpo

migration.identity_registry_owner.reason: A field, constraint, reference, or index entry must carry the stable identity of the entity that owns its semantic path.
migration.identity_registry_owner.recommendedNextStep: Restore a valid registry or reapply the change through schema commands
migration.identity_registry_owner.summary: Schema identity has the wrong entity owner

migration.identity_registry_read_failed.reason: The registry or snapshot path was unavailable, so the compiler cannot validate persistent identity before changing schema artifacts.
migration.identity_registry_read_failed.recommendedNextStep: Restore read access and retry the schema operation
migration.identity_registry_read_failed.summary: Schema identity file could not be read

migration.identity_registry_write_failed.reason: A checked initialization, addition, or rename could not persist its canonical identity update.
migration.identity_registry_write_failed.recommendedNextStep: Restore write access and retry the same schema operation
migration.identity_registry_write_failed.summary: Schema identity registry could not be written

migration.identity_rename_kind.reason: Identity-preserving rename currently accepts only an `entity` or `field` semantic path.
migration.identity_rename_kind.recommendedNextStep: Choose `entity` or `field` as the rename kind
migration.identity_rename_kind.summary: Schema rename kind is not supported

migration.identity_rename_source_unknown.reason: The old semantic path is not registered under the selected kind, so there is no stable identity to carry forward.
migration.identity_rename_source_unknown.recommendedNextStep: Use the registered old path and matching kind
migration.identity_rename_source_unknown.summary: Schema rename source identity does not exist

migration.identity_rename_target_exists.reason: Moving the old stable identity onto an already registered target would merge two distinct persistent objects.
migration.identity_rename_target_exists.recommendedNextStep: Choose the unregistered renamed target or resolve the existing identity first
migration.identity_rename_target_exists.summary: Schema rename target already has an identity

migration.identity_rename_target_unknown.reason: The new semantic path must already exist in the source before its old stable identity can be reassigned.
migration.identity_rename_target_unknown.recommendedNextStep: Rename the source declaration first, then update its registry identity
migration.identity_rename_target_unknown.summary: Schema rename target is absent from checked source

migration.identity_snapshot_exists.reason: Snapshots are immutable comparison inputs and are never overwritten after review or archival.
migration.identity_snapshot_exists.recommendedNextStep: Choose a new output path or use the existing snapshot

migration.identity_snapshot_invalid.reason: The snapshot JSON does not match the versioned format Jadpo needs to compare stored schema definitions.
migration.identity_snapshot_invalid.recommendedNextStep: Create a new snapshot with `jadpo schema snapshot`

migration.identity_snapshot_missing.reason: The requested comparison needs an immutable earlier snapshot, but the selected path does not exist.

migration.identity_snapshot_not_canonica.reason: The parsed snapshot differs from Jadpo's exact serialization, indicating it was edited or produced by an incompatible process.
migration.identity_snapshot_not_canonica.recommendedNextStep: Recreate the snapshot using `jadpo schema snapshot`
migration.identity_snapshot_not_canonica.summary: Previous schema snapshot is not canonical

migration.identity_snapshot_shape_missin.reason: Each snapshot entry must include its previous fields and storage rules so Jadpo can identify what changed and plan a review.
migration.identity_snapshot_shape_missin.recommendedNextStep: Regenerate the snapshot from a valid identity registry
migration.identity_snapshot_shape_missin.summary: Snapshot entry is missing its saved definition

migration.identity_snapshot_write_failed.reason: The compiler derived a canonical immutable snapshot but could not create the selected output file.
migration.identity_snapshot_write_failed.recommendedNextStep: Choose a writable output path and take the snapshot again
migration.identity_snapshot_write_failed.summary: Schema snapshot could not be written

migration.plan_adapter_invalid.reason: Migration planning and SQL review currently require an explicit `postgres` or `sqlite` adapter because their operations differ.

migration.plan_decision_rejects_change.reason: The human-selected `reject` strategy intentionally denies this change, so the compiler will not turn it into a migration plan.
migration.plan_decision_rejects_change.summary: Reviewed decision rejects this schema change

migration.plan_exists.reason: Plans are immutable review artifacts and are never overwritten because replacement could invalidate an approval trail.
migration.plan_exists.recommendedNextStep: Choose a new output path or review the existing plan

migration.plan_write_failed.reason: The compiler validated the bound decisions and derived the non-executable plan but could not create its output file.
migration.plan_write_failed.recommendedNextStep: Choose a writable output path and generate the plan again
migration.plan_write_failed.summary: Migration plan could not be written

migration.sql_change_unsupported.reason: The non-executable migration plan can describe this reviewed change, but the selected adapter cannot yet derive safe forward and rollback SQL for it.
migration.sql_change_unsupported.recommendedNextStep: Review the migration plan and author the unsupported operation outside generated SQL
migration.sql_change_unsupported.summary: Schema change has no SQL review generator

migration.sql_expression_unsupported.reason: Generated migration SQL currently accepts only the explicit `literal(...)` evidence form; arbitrary application expressions are not executed during migration.
migration.sql_expression_unsupported.recommendedNextStep: Use a typed `literal(...)` backfill value or keep the step manual
migration.sql_expression_unsupported.summary: Backfill expression cannot be compiled to SQL

migration.sql_field_owner_missing.reason: The field snapshot or identity registry does not link this persistent field to a registered entity table, so SQL cannot address it safely.
migration.sql_field_owner_missing.recommendedNextStep: Restore and validate the schema identity registry before regenerating SQL
migration.sql_field_owner_missing.summary: Migration field has no resolvable owning table

migration.sql_field_shape_invalid.reason: The snapshot does not contain the field type and nullability Jadpo needs to choose the correct SQL operation.
migration.sql_field_shape_invalid.recommendedNextStep: Regenerate valid schema identities and snapshots before planning this change

migration.sql_literal_invalid.reason: The reviewed literal cannot be parsed as the target Text, UUID, Instant, CalendarDate, Int, Decimal, or Boolean value without changing its meaning.
migration.sql_literal_invalid.recommendedNextStep: Provide a valid typed literal for the target field
migration.sql_literal_invalid.summary: Backfill literal is invalid for the field type

migration.sql_predicate_unsupported.reason: Making a nullable field required needs the exact `not_null` check. Jadpo cannot treat another check as proof that existing rows are safe.
migration.sql_predicate_unsupported.recommendedNextStep: Use `not_null` evidence or keep the narrowing outside generated SQL
migration.sql_predicate_unsupported.summary: Validation check cannot be compiled to SQL

migration.sql_review_exists.reason: SQL reviews are immutable, non-executable approval artifacts and are never overwritten after generation.
migration.sql_review_exists.recommendedNextStep: Choose a new output path or review the existing SQL artifact
migration.sql_review_exists.summary: Migration SQL review output already exists

migration.sql_review_write_failed.reason: The compiler derived forward and rollback statements but could not create the immutable review output.
migration.sql_review_write_failed.recommendedNextStep: Choose a writable output path and generate the SQL review again
migration.sql_review_write_failed.summary: Migration SQL review could not be written

migration.sql_sqlite_constraint_missing.reason: Recreating the table requires the stable physical name of each primary, unique, or compound-unique constraint, and one is absent from the registry.
migration.sql_sqlite_constraint_missing.recommendedNextStep: Restore and validate the identity registry before regenerating the SQLite review
migration.sql_sqlite_constraint_missing.summary: SQLite rebuild cannot resolve a constraint identity

migration.sql_sqlite_entity_missing.reason: The registered table does not match a checked entity declaration with all fields needed to recreate it.
migration.sql_sqlite_entity_missing.recommendedNextStep: Restore consistency between source and the identity registry
migration.sql_sqlite_entity_missing.summary: SQLite rebuild cannot find the current entity

migration.sql_sqlite_field_identity_miss.reason: Copying rows into a rebuilt table requires each retained field's stable physical column name, and one is absent from the registry.
migration.sql_sqlite_field_identity_miss.recommendedNextStep: Restore and validate the field identities before regenerating SQL
migration.sql_sqlite_field_identity_miss.summary: SQLite rebuild cannot resolve a field identity

migration.sql_sqlite_field_missing.reason: A changed snapshot field does not resolve to a checked field on the entity being rebuilt, so its source and destination columns cannot be proven.
migration.sql_sqlite_field_missing.recommendedNextStep: Restore consistency between the snapshot, source, and identity registry
migration.sql_sqlite_field_missing.summary: SQLite rebuild cannot find the current field

migration.sql_sqlite_index_missing.reason: Recreating the table requires the stable physical name of every retained index, and one is absent from the registry.
migration.sql_sqlite_index_missing.recommendedNextStep: Restore and validate the index identities before regenerating SQL
migration.sql_sqlite_index_missing.summary: SQLite rebuild cannot resolve an index identity

migration.sql_sqlite_rebuild_required.reason: SQLite cannot express this field alteration as the direct `ALTER TABLE` operation used by the general path; it must be grouped into a checked rebuild.
migration.sql_sqlite_rebuild_required.recommendedNextStep: Generate this change as a supported isolated SQLite rebuild set
migration.sql_sqlite_rebuild_required.summary: SQLite change requires a table rebuild

migration.sql_sqlite_rebuild_unsupported.reason: The reviewed changes combine fields, ownership, modifiers, or constraints that Jadpo cannot yet reproduce safely in one table rebuild.
migration.sql_sqlite_rebuild_unsupported.recommendedNextStep: Split the change into supported steps or author and review the rebuild manually
migration.sql_sqlite_rebuild_unsupported.summary: This combination of SQLite table changes is not supported

migration.sql_sqlite_reference_missing.reason: Recreating a foreign key requires registered physical identities for its target table and column, and that mapping is incomplete.
migration.sql_sqlite_reference_missing.recommendedNextStep: Restore and validate relationship identities before regenerating SQL
migration.sql_sqlite_reference_missing.summary: SQLite rebuild cannot resolve a reference target

migration.sql_sqlite_renamed_table_unsup.reason: The bounded rebuild generator does not combine table-history resolution with a physical table recreation in one reviewed step.
migration.sql_sqlite_renamed_table_unsup.recommendedNextStep: Separate the rename lifecycle from the rebuild or author the reviewed SQL manually
migration.sql_sqlite_renamed_table_unsup.summary: SQLite rebuild cannot target a logically renamed table

migration.sql_strategy_unsupported.reason: The selected strategy is valid for planning but does not match the bounded adapter operation required for this SQL review.
migration.sql_strategy_unsupported.recommendedNextStep: Choose a SQL-supported strategy through a new review or keep the step manual
migration.sql_strategy_unsupported.summary: Reviewed migration strategy has no SQL implementation

migration.sql_type_unsupported.reason: Jadpo does not know which database column type safely represents this named field type for the selected database.
migration.sql_type_unsupported.recommendedNextStep: Use a supported storage representation or author and review the type migration manually
migration.sql_type_unsupported.summary: Field type has no migration SQL mapping

module.duplicate_import.reason: A module scope may bind an imported declaration name only once; repeated imports do not create a second distinct value or type.
module.duplicate_import.recommendedNextStep: Keep one import of this declaration
module.duplicate_import.summary: Declaration is imported more than once

module.duplicate_module.reason: Each explicit module has one source file so its exports, imports, and declaration scope have a single owner.
module.duplicate_module.recommendedNextStep: Give each module file a unique module name
module.duplicate_module.summary: Module name is declared by more than one file

module.import_conflict.reason: The module already declares this name locally, so importing another declaration under the same name would make references ambiguous.
module.import_conflict.recommendedNextStep: Remove the import or rename one of the declarations
module.import_conflict.summary: Imported name conflicts with a local declaration

module.import_cycle.reason: Modules must have an acyclic dependency order so declarations can be resolved and generated deterministically.
module.import_cycle.recommendedNextStep: Move shared declarations or remove an import to break the cycle

module.import_required.reason: In explicit-module mode, declarations from another file are visible only when selected by an import in the current module.
module.import_required.recommendedNextStep: Import the declaration from its module
module.import_required.summary: Declaration is used without being imported

module.module_required.reason: Once any source uses explicit modules, every source file must declare its module so cross-file visibility is deterministic.
module.module_required.recommendedNextStep: Add a module declaration to this file
module.module_required.summary: Source file is missing its module declaration

module.private_import.reason: The target declaration exists but is not listed as public by its owning module, so another module cannot select it.
module.private_import.recommendedNextStep: Export the declaration from its module or stop importing it
module.private_import.summary: Imported declaration is private to its module

module.public_requires_module.reason: A public declaration needs an owning module boundary; export markers cannot be used while the project is in implicit single-scope mode.
module.public_requires_module.recommendedNextStep: Declare modules for the project or remove the public export

module.self_import.reason: Declarations in the current module are already in scope, and a self-import would create a dependency cycle without adding visibility.

module.standard_namespace_import.reason: Compiler-owned namespaces are already in scope and must remain qualified; selective imports would create a second unqualified call form.
module.standard_namespace_import.recommendedNextStep: Remove this import and call the operation through its standard namespace

module.standard_namespace_reserved.reason: The first module segment cannot be `temporal`, `collection`, or another compiler-owned namespace because authored modules are not runtime namespace objects.
module.standard_namespace_reserved.recommendedNextStep: Choose an application-owned lower_snake_case module name
module.standard_namespace_reserved.summary: Module name conflicts with a standard-library namespace

module.unknown_export.reason: The selected name is neither a public export nor a private declaration in the module being imported.
module.unknown_export.recommendedNextStep: Correct the imported name or add and export that declaration
module.unknown_export.summary: Imported declaration does not exist in the target module

module.unknown_module.reason: No source file declares the module named by this import, so its selected declarations cannot be resolved.
module.unknown_module.recommendedNextStep: Correct the module path or add the missing module file

policy.binding_duplicate.reason: A direct principal relationship establishes at most one fixed qualified role fact.
policy.binding_duplicate.summary: Field declares more than one role binding

policy.binding_invalid.reason: A role fact must come from a checked principal reference or persistent membership with compatible scope, member, and closed role-enum fields.
policy.binding_invalid.recommendedNextStep: Correct the binding fields and use a qualified declared role
policy.binding_invalid.summary: Role binding is not authoritative or type-compatible

policy.binding_mutable.reason: Changing a role source changes future authority and requires a separately reviewed transfer operation.

policy.declaration_duplicate.reason: An entity or exceptional field has one role-first policy matrix so permission sources cannot drift.
policy.declaration_duplicate.recommendedNextStep: Combine the rules into one policy block
policy.declaration_duplicate.summary: Protected item declares policy more than once

policy.effect_duplicate.reason: Each subject-to-effect grant has one canonical entry in its role-first matrix.

policy.effect_ungranted.reason: Policy is default-deny: every derived create, read, update, or delete effect needs at least one permitted authoritative subject.
policy.effect_ungranted.recommendedNextStep: Declare the intended qualified role or access subject at the entity policy
policy.effect_ungranted.summary: Reachable entity effect has no policy grant

policy.effect_unknown.reason: Entity policy uses only `create`, `read`, `update`, and `delete`; independently protected non-entity operations use `invoke`.
policy.effect_unknown.recommendedNextStep: Use the semantic effect derived from the protected operation

policy.field_widens_entity.reason: Exceptional field policy is an additional narrowing gate and cannot grant a role or effect absent from the containing entity policy.
policy.field_widens_entity.recommendedNextStep: Narrow the field rule or deliberately review the entity-level grant
policy.field_widens_entity.summary: Field policy would widen entity permission

policy.invoke_context.reason: Only a non-entity action or query can own a local `invoke` policy; entity matrices use create, read, update, and delete.
policy.invoke_context.recommendedNextStep: Move the invoke rule into the independently protected operation or use the entity's derived effect
policy.invoke_context.summary: Invoke policy is attached to the wrong kind of declaration

policy.membership_duplicate.reason: One membership declaration must identify the authoritative scope, member, and qualified role fields without competing bindings.
policy.membership_duplicate.recommendedNextStep: Combine the role binding into one membership declaration
policy.membership_duplicate.summary: Entity declares membership more than once

policy.membership_member_required.reason: A membership must identify the user or service principal that receives its role fact.

policy.membership_role_required.reason: A membership must name the closed enum field containing its qualified scoped role.

policy.membership_scope_required.reason: A scoped role fact must identify the authoritative resource or tenant that bounds it.

policy.operation_effect_mismatch.reason: Operation exceptions are checked against the derived persistence graph and cannot invent or omit reached entity effects.
policy.operation_effect_mismatch.recommendedNextStep: Match the exception to the operation's derived effects
policy.operation_effect_mismatch.summary: Policy exception names an effect the operation does not perform

policy.operation_unknown.reason: A named exception can replace inherited permissions only for one checked operation owned by the protected entity.
policy.operation_unknown.recommendedNextStep: Correct the operation name or remove the unused exception
policy.operation_unknown.summary: Policy exception names an unknown entity operation

policy.output_field_unproved.reason: A narrowing field policy must admit every subject that can reach the operation output; output serialization never removes a forbidden field silently.
policy.output_field_unproved.recommendedNextStep: Return a projection without the field or narrow the named operation to subjects allowed to read it
policy.output_field_unproved.summary: Operation output exposes a field to a broader role set

policy.public_grant_missing.reason: `auth: none` removes authentication only at the transport boundary; protected entity access also requires an explicit `Access.public` grant.
policy.public_grant_missing.recommendedNextStep: Protect the route or deliberately grant `Access.public` for the reached effect
policy.public_grant_missing.summary: Public route reaches an entity without public permission

policy.role_field_create_forbidden.reason: A caller-controlled owner relationship could manufacture authority even when its identifier has the correct declared type.
policy.role_field_create_forbidden.recommendedNextStep: Construct the role-binding field from the matching typed `principal` identity
policy.role_field_create_forbidden.summary: Role-binding field is not derived from the authenticated principal

policy.role_field_update_forbidden.reason: Ownership, tenant scope, and membership role fields cannot change through general update permission.
policy.role_field_update_forbidden.recommendedNextStep: Make the field immutable or design a named reviewed transfer operation
policy.role_field_update_forbidden.summary: Role-binding field is writable by an ordinary update

policy.role_unbound.reason: Declaring a role enum does not grant authority; the compiler needs a direct principal relationship or persistent membership source for its scope.
policy.role_unbound.recommendedNextStep: Add an authoritative direct or membership role binding
policy.role_unbound.summary: Policy role has no authoritative binding

policy.scope_ambiguous.reason: Choosing a scope by field name, order, route parameter, or caller input could authorize the wrong tenant.
policy.scope_ambiguous.recommendedNextStep: Add one explicit `scope:` selection to the entity policy
policy.scope_ambiguous.summary: Protected entity has more than one possible role scope

policy.scope_duplicate.reason: A protected entity needs one unambiguous scope path for each scoped role namespace.
policy.scope_duplicate.summary: Policy selects scope more than once

policy.scope_missing.reason: A scoped role can authorize only rows connected to its authoritative resource or tenant scope.
policy.scope_missing.recommendedNextStep: Add the missing typed scope relationship or correct the explicit scope field
policy.scope_missing.summary: Protected entity has no path to the role scope

policy.subject_duplicate.reason: One canonical role-first entry prevents grants for the same qualified subject from being split or drifting.
policy.subject_duplicate.recommendedNextStep: Combine the effects into one subject entry

route.auth_value_invalid.reason: Routes require authentication by default. The only explicit opt-out is the exact form `auth: none`, so the compiler cannot infer whether `{found}` was meant to retain authentication or disable it.
route.auth_value_invalid.summary: Route authentication value `{found}` is not valid

route.behaviour_conflict.reason: A route must select exactly one local inline action or one named `run:` invocation.

route.behaviour_required.reason: A route must select exactly one local inline action or one named `run:` invocation.

route.deadline_invalid.reason: A route deadline is a fixed duration written in whole milliseconds using `ms`, `s`, `m`, or `h`. Zero, fractional milliseconds, days, and values outside the portable runtime range are not supported.
route.deadline_invalid.recommendedNextStep: Use a positive `deadline:` duration in `ms`, `s`, `m`, or `h`
route.deadline_invalid.summary: Route deadline must be a finite positive duration

route.header_from_required.reason: Each ordinary header binding uses `name: Type from "HTTP-Name"` so source names never imply transport casing or collide with compiler-owned headers.
route.header_from_required.recommendedNextStep: Add `from` followed by the exact HTTP header name
route.header_from_required.summary: Route header binding needs an explicit wire name

route.item_colon_required.reason: Every route item uses the same explicit `name: value` separator, including block-valued path and action items.
route.item_colon_required.recommendedNextStep: Insert `:` after the route item name

route.item_duplicate.reason: A route has one authentication setting, path schema, input, output, success mode, and behavior selection. Repeating an item would silently replace part of its public contract.
route.item_duplicate.recommendedNextStep: Keep one occurrence of this route item
route.item_duplicate.summary: Route item is declared more than once

route.path_binding_duplicate.reason: Each typed field in `path:` must bind one distinct placeholder; duplicate names cannot identify separate decoded path segments.
route.path_binding_duplicate.recommendedNextStep: Rename or remove the repeated path field
route.path_binding_duplicate.summary: Route path binding name is repeated
