route.path_binding_extra.reason: Route placeholders and typed `path` fields must correspond exactly one-to-one.
route.path_binding_extra.recommendedNextStep: Remove the typed path field that has no placeholder
route.path_binding_extra.summary: Typed path binding has no placeholder

route.path_binding_missing.reason: Route placeholders and typed `path` fields must correspond exactly one-to-one.
route.path_binding_missing.recommendedNextStep: Add a typed path field for the route placeholder
route.path_binding_missing.summary: Route placeholder has no typed binding

route.path_field_modifier_invalid.reason: A value inside the URL path is always required and can declare only its type. It cannot be nullable, optional, stored, indexed, or a relationship.
route.path_field_modifier_invalid.recommendedNextStep: Remove the modifier and keep only `name: Type`
route.path_field_modifier_invalid.summary: Route path field has an unsupported modifier

route.path_placeholder_duplicate.reason: A placeholder name may occur once in a route path; repeating it would map one typed binding to multiple URL segments ambiguously.
route.path_placeholder_duplicate.recommendedNextStep: Give each route placeholder a distinct name

route.path_placeholder_invalid.reason: A placeholder uses `{name}` with a non-empty Jadpo name beginning with a letter or underscore and ending with a closing brace.
route.path_placeholder_invalid.recommendedNextStep: Correct the placeholder to the `{name}` form
route.path_placeholder_invalid.summary: Route path contains an invalid placeholder

runtime.outcome_unknown.reason: The generated runtime contained an operation whose external effect may have committed, so it returned a safe uncertainty response without retrying.
runtime.outcome_unknown.recommendedNextStep: Inspect the matching uncertain operation before attempting reconciliation
runtime.outcome_unknown.summary: Generated runtime could not confirm whether an effect committed

runtime.startup_failed.reason: The generated runtime could not establish its startup contract and did not report readiness.
runtime.startup_failed.recommendedNextStep: Inspect the generated runtime startup event before retrying

runtime.unhandled_fault.reason: An exception outside the declared domain-failure boundary was contained by the generated runtime.
runtime.unhandled_fault.recommendedNextStep: Inspect the matching local incident using its request identifier
runtime.unhandled_fault.summary: Generated runtime contained an unexpected fault

semantic.application_principal_shape.reason: The authentication default names the closed principal declaration directly; it cannot be nullable, generic, or a field path.
semantic.application_principal_shape.recommendedNextStep: Use the plain name of the project principal declaration
semantic.application_principal_shape.summary: Application principal must name one declaration

semantic.auth_bearer_location_forbidden.reason: Bearer credentials are accepted only from the reserved authorization header and never from a path or query value.
semantic.auth_bearer_location_forbidden.summary: Bearer credential location is not allowed

semantic.auth_credential_slot_duplicate.reason: A request credential must select at most one strategy. Reusing a cookie or bearer location would make selection ambiguous.
semantic.auth_credential_slot_duplicate.recommendedNextStep: Give each authentication strategy one distinct credential location
semantic.auth_credential_slot_duplicate.summary: Credential location is configured more than once

semantic.auth_mapping_duplicate.reason: Each principal field has one provenance. Competing claim or authority mappings would make identity construction ambiguous.
semantic.auth_mapping_duplicate.recommendedNextStep: Keep one mapping for the principal field
semantic.auth_mapping_duplicate.summary: Authentication mapping writes the same principal field twice

semantic.auth_mapping_required.reason: Authoritative resolution must construct the declared principal variant from explicit validated authority fields.
semantic.auth_mapping_required.recommendedNextStep: Add at least one authority-to-principal field mapping
semantic.auth_mapping_required.summary: Principal resolution has no field mappings

semantic.auth_mapping_target_invalid.reason: Authentication mappings may populate only a field of the declared closed user or service principal variant.
semantic.auth_mapping_target_invalid.recommendedNextStep: Map to a field such as `Principal.user.subject`
semantic.auth_mapping_target_invalid.summary: Authentication mapping target is not a matching principal field

semantic.auth_principal_variant_unknown.reason: Every strategy must resolve to exactly one variant of the closed provider-independent principal: user or service.
semantic.auth_principal_variant_unknown.summary: Authentication strategy principal variant is not supported

semantic.auth_resolution_authority_inval.reason: Authoritative resolution starts from one inventoried entity field such as `User.authentication_subject`.
semantic.auth_resolution_authority_inval.recommendedNextStep: Name the entity field that resolves this principal
semantic.auth_resolution_authority_inval.summary: Principal resolution authority must name one entity field

semantic.auth_resolution_duplicate.reason: Each strategy has one unambiguous authoritative resolution path for each principal variant it can produce.
semantic.auth_resolution_duplicate.recommendedNextStep: Combine the duplicate principal resolution declarations
semantic.auth_resolution_duplicate.summary: Principal variant has more than one resolution declaration

semantic.auth_strategy_duplicate.reason: Each named authentication strategy identifies one credential transport, validation mode, and principal variant.
semantic.auth_strategy_duplicate.recommendedNextStep: Rename or combine the duplicate authentication strategy
semantic.auth_strategy_duplicate.summary: Authentication strategy name is already in use

semantic.auth_validation_mode_unknown.reason: The initial authentication contract supports signed, opaque, API-key, and JWT validation with compiler-owned security policy.
semantic.auth_validation_mode_unknown.summary: Authentication validation mode is not supported

semantic.auth_validator_duplicate.reason: Validator names identify one validation mode and principal mapping within their authentication strategy.
semantic.auth_validator_duplicate.recommendedNextStep: Rename or combine the duplicate authentication validator
semantic.auth_validator_duplicate.summary: Authentication validator name is already in use

semantic.auth_validator_required.reason: A configured credential location must have at least one named validator that resolves to one principal variant.
semantic.auth_validator_required.recommendedNextStep: Add a named validator to the authentication strategy

semantic.duplicate_declaration.reason: Every visible name must identify one thing. Two declarations with the same name would make later references ambiguous.
semantic.duplicate_declaration.recommendedNextStep: Rename one of the declarations or remove the duplicate
semantic.duplicate_declaration.summary: A name is defined more than once

semantic.multiple_applications.reason: One application declaration owns the project-wide authentication default and other application capabilities.
semantic.multiple_applications.recommendedNextStep: Keep one application declaration and combine its settings
semantic.multiple_applications.summary: Project declares more than one application

semantic.multiple_locale_declarations.reason: One closed locale declaration owns formatting support, fallback behavior, and the generated `Locale` enum for the whole application.
semantic.multiple_locale_declarations.recommendedNextStep: Keep one locales declaration and combine its supported values
semantic.multiple_locale_declarations.summary: Project declares more than one locale set

semantic.multiple_principals.reason: Authentication strategies must converge on one closed provider-independent principal declaration.
semantic.multiple_principals.recommendedNextStep: Keep one principal declaration and combine its variants
semantic.multiple_principals.summary: Project declares more than one principal

semantic.name_case.reason: This name's semantic owner determines one language-wide spelling. Type-like declarations use UpperCamelCase, while runtime names use lower_snake_case.

semantic.not_callable.reason: Only a function or action can be followed by parentheses and called.
semantic.not_callable.recommendedNextStep: Call a function or action instead, or remove the parentheses

semantic.principal_variant_duplicate.reason: The closed principal has exactly one user variant and one service variant.
semantic.principal_variant_duplicate.recommendedNextStep: Keep one declaration of this principal variant
semantic.principal_variant_duplicate.summary: Principal variant is declared more than once

semantic.principal_variant_required.reason: The v0.1 principal contract is closed over both user and service identities, even when one client class is not configured yet.
semantic.principal_variant_required.recommendedNextStep: Declare both the user and service principal variants
semantic.principal_variant_required.summary: Principal is missing a required variant

semantic.revocation_delay_forbidden.reason: Immediate mode performs an authoritative check for each authenticated request and therefore has no bounded-delay contract.
semantic.revocation_delay_forbidden.summary: Immediate revocation cannot declare a bounded delay

semantic.revocation_delay_invalid.reason: A zero or negative interval cannot express a meaningful bounded revocation guarantee.

semantic.revocation_delay_required.reason: A bounded credential must state the longest interval before authority changes are guaranteed to take effect.
semantic.revocation_delay_required.summary: Bounded revocation requires a maximum delay

semantic.service_atomic_effect.reason: A network request cannot participate in the database write's commit or rollback. A durable intent must commit before dispatch so a crash cannot lose or duplicate the external operation.
semantic.service_atomic_effect.recommendedNextStep: Move dispatch behind a committed durable intent or separate it from the database write
semantic.service_atomic_effect.summary: External service effect cannot share an uncommitted write

semantic.service_call_context.reason: This checked operation performs network I/O and may produce uncertain outcomes, so pure functions and read-only queries cannot invoke it.
semantic.service_call_context.recommendedNextStep: Move the call into an action with its complete declared failure set
semantic.service_call_context.summary: External service operation requires an effectful caller

semantic.service_configuration_missing.reason: A service must resolve its typed secret slot against the project's declared configuration field.
semantic.service_configuration_missing.recommendedNextStep: Declare the mail API key as a secret configuration field
semantic.service_configuration_missing.summary: Service credential slot requires a project configuration declaration

semantic.service_contract_invalid.reason: This compiler slice accepts one closed operation and its reviewed request, response, retry and outcome rules. Unsupported additions are rejected instead of being silently ignored.
semantic.service_contract_invalid.recommendedNextStep: Restore the checked ReminderMail operation or plan a reviewed contract expansion
semantic.service_contract_invalid.summary: Service declaration is outside the checked contract slice

semantic.service_egress_invalid.reason: The first service slice admits one statically declared HTTPS host and port. Dynamic or mismatched egress could send credentials or payloads to an undeclared destination.
semantic.service_egress_invalid.recommendedNextStep: Use the declared mail provider authority or plan a reviewed provider contract
semantic.service_egress_invalid.summary: Service egress must match its fixed authority

semantic.service_idempotency_invalid.reason: The operation must bind its request and provider idempotency header to the persisted nominal ReminderIntentId. An attempt identity or missing key could duplicate a delivery.
semantic.service_idempotency_invalid.recommendedNextStep: Use ReminderIntentId for the operation idempotency key
semantic.service_idempotency_invalid.summary: Service operation lacks its stable delivery identity

semantic.service_import_digest_mismatch.reason: The imported file does not match its declared SHA-256. The compiler will not accept a mutable or stale provider contract.
semantic.service_import_digest_mismatch.recommendedNextStep: Restore the reviewed snapshot or plan a separately reviewed contract successor
semantic.service_import_digest_mismatch.summary: Pinned service contract bytes have changed

semantic.service_import_not_found.reason: The service declaration names a repository snapshot that the compiler cannot read, so it cannot verify the imported contract.
semantic.service_import_not_found.recommendedNextStep: Restore the pinned contract file inside the project
semantic.service_import_not_found.summary: Pinned service contract file is unavailable

semantic.service_import_pin_invalid.reason: This service slice accepts only the checked repository snapshot at its exact version and SHA-256. Missing or changed import metadata cannot establish which provider contract was reviewed.
semantic.service_import_pin_invalid.recommendedNextStep: Restore the pinned service contract import
semantic.service_import_pin_invalid.summary: Service import must pin one supported contract snapshot

semantic.service_secret_sink_invalid.reason: Only the declared bearer credential from the secret mail configuration slot may enter the fixed Authorization header. Other secret paths or sinks are rejected.
semantic.service_secret_sink_invalid.recommendedNextStep: Restore the declared credential slot and Authorization header
semantic.service_secret_sink_invalid.summary: Service credential sink is not permitted

semantic.standard_namespace_reserved.reason: Standard-library namespaces are always available without imports and cannot be declared, shadowed, opened, or aliased by application source.

semantic.standard_operation_qualificatio.reason: Standard operations have one canonical source spelling and cannot be called as free functions or receiver methods.
semantic.standard_operation_qualificatio.summary: Standard-library operation requires its owning namespace

semantic.standard_operation_reserved.reason: A free callable cannot duplicate a compiler-owned operation because that would create qualified and unqualified spellings for the same concept.
semantic.standard_operation_reserved.recommendedNextStep: Choose a domain-specific callable name and use the standard operation through its namespace
semantic.standard_operation_reserved.summary: `{name}` is reserved for a standard-library operation

semantic.test_service_fake_required.reason: A generated authored test cannot dispatch to a real external provider. Every service operation reachable from the test must be supplied by its typed fixture fake.
semantic.test_service_fake_required.recommendedNextStep: Add the service's declared fake to the test fixture
semantic.test_service_fake_required.summary: Authored tests must fake external service calls

semantic.unknown_callee.reason: Jadpo could not find a visible function or action with this name.
semantic.unknown_callee.recommendedNextStep: Correct the name, define the function or action, or import it
semantic.unknown_callee.summary: Called function or action isn't defined

semantic.unknown_name.reason: Jadpo could not find this name among local values, declarations, imports, or built-in types.
semantic.unknown_name.recommendedNextStep: Correct the name, define it, or import it

semantic.wrong_name_kind.reason: The name exists, but this part of the source needs something different, such as a type, failure, function, or predefined category.
semantic.wrong_name_kind.recommendedNextStep: Use a name that is valid here
semantic.wrong_name_kind.summary: This name can't be used here

syntax.constraint_colon_required.reason: Every type constraint uses the explicit `name: value` form. The old `format email` spelling is not valid.

syntax.constraint_non_entity.reason: This constraint describes stored data, so its object type needs a separate `persist Type { ... }` declaration.
syntax.constraint_non_entity.recommendedNextStep: Move the constraint into the object's `persist` declaration, or remove it
syntax.constraint_non_entity.summary: Persistence constraints require a persisted object

syntax.duplicate_field_modifier.reason: Each field modifier may be written once. Repeating a modifier makes the field's authored storage or validation contract ambiguous.
syntax.duplicate_field_modifier.recommendedNextStep: Keep one occurrence of the repeated field modifier

syntax.empty_import.reason: A selective import must name at least one declaration from the target module; an empty selection introduces no usable name.
syntax.empty_import.recommendedNextStep: Add at least one imported declaration name, or remove the import

syntax.enum_empty.reason: An enum is a closed set of named values and must contain at least one variant so construction and matching have a defined domain.
syntax.enum_empty.recommendedNextStep: Add at least one enum variant

syntax.expected_constraint.reason: A type constraint block accepts only supported constraint names such as length, numeric bound, pattern, or format constraints.
syntax.expected_constraint.recommendedNextStep: Use a supported constraint name or remove the invalid item

syntax.expected_constraint_value.reason: The preceding constraint name is incomplete without the literal or name that defines its bound, pattern, or format.
syntax.expected_constraint_value.recommendedNextStep: Add a value of the kind required by this constraint

syntax.expected_declaration.reason: Jadpo files accept `type`, `persist`, `failure`, `function`, `action`, `test`, and `route` declarations at the top level. Optional `module` and `import` headers come before those declarations. Route items such as `path:` belong inside a `route` block, so `{found}` cannot be parsed here.
syntax.expected_declaration.recommendedNextStep: Move `{found}` into its owning declaration, or replace it with a top-level declaration

syntax.expected_delete_action.reason: A `delete required` expression must name the persisted object whose stored row will be removed before its predicate and failure bindings can be parsed.
syntax.expected_delete_action.recommendedNextStep: Add the persisted object type after `delete required`
syntax.expected_delete_action.summary: Delete requires a persisted object type

syntax.expected_expression.reason: Jadpo needs a value here, such as a literal, name, function call, constructed value, match, or persistence operation.
syntax.expected_expression.recommendedNextStep: Add the value or operation you intended

syntax.expected_failure_item.reason: A failure body accepts `kind`, `code`, `message`, `public`, and `internal` items only.
syntax.expected_failure_item.recommendedNextStep: Replace this item with a supported failure member or remove it
syntax.expected_failure_item.summary: Failure declaration contains an unsupported item

syntax.expected_field_initialiser.reason: A constructor or object body assigns fields with `name: expression`; each item needs a field name before its value.
syntax.expected_field_initialiser.recommendedNextStep: Add a named field initialiser or remove the stray item

syntax.expected_http_method.reason: A route declaration starts with exactly one of `GET`, `POST`, `PUT`, `PATCH`, or `DELETE` before its path.
syntax.expected_http_method.recommendedNextStep: Add a supported HTTP method before the route path

syntax.expected_inverse_cardinality.reason: Jadpo needs to know whether this relationship can return at most one record or a list of records.
syntax.expected_inverse_cardinality.recommendedNextStep: Add `optional` or `many` to the inverse relationship

syntax.expected_invocation.reason: Named route behavior calls an action with parentheses. A bare name or another expression does not define the route's argument mapping.

syntax.expected_literal.reason: Jadpo needs a value written directly here, such as text, a number, `true`, `false`, or `none`.
syntax.expected_literal.recommendedNextStep: Replace this with the required literal value

syntax.expected_name.reason: Jadpo needs the name of a declaration, field, local value, or qualified path here.
syntax.expected_name.recommendedNextStep: Add a valid name beginning with a letter or underscore

syntax.expected_order_direction.reason: Every `order_by` field needs an explicit direction so result ordering is deterministic across storage adapters.
syntax.expected_order_direction.recommendedNextStep: Add `asc` or `desc` after the ordering field

syntax.expected_patch_input.reason: The `patch:` item must name the input value whose supplied fields will be applied to the persisted object.
syntax.expected_patch_input.recommendedNextStep: Add the patch input value after `patch:`
syntax.expected_patch_input.summary: Patch update requires an omission-aware object

syntax.expected_route_item.reason: A route body accepts `auth:`, `path:`, `query:`, `headers:`, `deadline:`, `input:`, `output:`, `success:`, `run:`, and `action:` items only.
syntax.expected_route_item.recommendedNextStep: Use a supported route item or move this source outside the route

syntax.expected_statement.reason: Callable and test blocks contain supported statements such as variable declarations, return, reject, conditionals, matches, assertions, and persistence operations.
syntax.expected_statement.recommendedNextStep: Add a supported statement or remove the stray source

syntax.expected_supplied.reason: A conditional patch assignment must explicitly test whether an optional input field was supplied before using its value.
syntax.expected_supplied.recommendedNextStep: Add `supplied` with the optional patch field

syntax.expected_supplied_field.reason: The `supplied` condition must name the optional input field whose presence controls the conditional patch assignment.
syntax.expected_supplied_field.recommendedNextStep: Add the optional input field after `supplied`

syntax.expected_update_body.reason: After its target and predicate, an update must choose either fixed authored changes with `set:` or omission-aware input changes with `patch:`.
syntax.expected_update_body.recommendedNextStep: Add the intended `set:` or `patch:` update body

syntax.failure_code_required.reason: Every failure declaration needs one string `code` so generated transports can identify the failure without exposing internal details.
syntax.failure_code_required.recommendedNextStep: Add a unique string `code` to the failure declaration
syntax.failure_code_required.summary: Failure requires a stable public code

syntax.failure_item_colon_required.reason: Failure metadata uses the same explicit `name: value` form as other named settings, such as `kind: NotFound` and `code: "customer_not_found"`.
syntax.failure_item_colon_required.recommendedNextStep: Insert `:` after the failure member name

syntax.failure_kind_required.reason: Every failure needs a `kind`, such as `InvalidValue`, `NotFound`, `Conflict`, or `Unavailable`, so Jadpo knows how to present it at a route boundary.

syntax.generated_on_required.reason: Compiler-owned lifecycle timestamps are explicit. The generated block must state whether the value is set on creation or on creation and semantic change.
syntax.generated_on_required.summary: Generated field requires an `on` lifecycle role

syntax.generated_role_invalid.reason: The initial lifecycle contract has exactly two roles so timestamp ownership and update behavior remain predictable.
syntax.generated_role_invalid.summary: Generated field lifecycle role is not supported

syntax.import_requires_module.reason: A file that imports names must declare its own logical module first; otherwise visibility and dependency identity are undefined.
syntax.import_requires_module.recommendedNextStep: Add a `module` header before the imports

syntax.invalid_escape.reason: Jadpo strings support escapes for quotes, backslashes, newline, carriage return, and tab; this backslash sequence has no defined value.
syntax.invalid_escape.recommendedNextStep: Use a supported string escape or remove the backslash
syntax.invalid_escape.summary: String contains an unsupported escape sequence

syntax.inverse_non_entity.reason: An inverse relationship is derived from stored owning references, so it belongs in the object's `persist` declaration.
syntax.inverse_non_entity.recommendedNextStep: Move the inverse relationship into `persist`, or remove it
syntax.inverse_non_entity.summary: Inverse relationships require a persisted object

syntax.job_clause_required.reason: The closed schedule entry needs one valid concurrency: singleton, run invocation and retry: next_schedule clause.
syntax.job_clause_required.summary: Job is missing a required clause

syntax.job_clause_value_invalid.reason: This checked schedule slice supports only concurrency: singleton and retry: next_schedule. The retry clause selects a wake-up, not a retry budget.
syntax.job_clause_value_invalid.recommendedNextStep: Use the closed supported clause value

syntax.job_delivery_direction_invalid.reason: The two-field ordered keyset retains due then identity order; each direction is asc.
syntax.job_delivery_direction_invalid.recommendedNextStep: Use the reviewed ordered ascending fields

syntax.job_delivery_key_duplicate.reason: Every required section and key occurs exactly once; later values cannot replace earlier ones.

syntax.job_delivery_key_required.reason: All five sections and all their closed keys require valid source values; a partial descriptor is not checked.

syntax.job_delivery_key_unknown.reason: Each descriptor section accepts only its closed key catalogue, not arbitrary expressions or configuration.

syntax.job_delivery_limit_invalid.reason: This closed descriptor has a fixed finite scan bound; dynamic, larger and unbounded limits are not supported.

syntax.job_delivery_mode_invalid.reason: Only the closed reminder_v1 source descriptor is parsed; it grants no execution or authority.

syntax.job_delivery_reference_invalid.reason: This slot accepts a checked field/configuration/operation reference, not an invocation, raw record or generated intent value.
syntax.job_delivery_reference_invalid.recommendedNextStep: Use a direct qualified source reference
syntax.job_delivery_reference_invalid.summary: Delivery slot requires a direct qualified reference

syntax.job_delivery_syntax_invalid.reason: Sections, references, open enum predicate and two-field cursor use the exact closed descriptor grammar.
syntax.job_delivery_syntax_invalid.recommendedNextStep: Restore the reviewed delivery descriptor syntax

syntax.job_delivery_term_invalid.reason: Compiler-origin descriptor terms are closed and position-specific, not ordinary values or caller-provided authority.
syntax.job_delivery_term_invalid.recommendedNextStep: Use the reviewed term for this slot

syntax.job_delivery_version_invalid.reason: The immutable closed payload uses the reviewed reminder.v1 version.

syntax.job_duration_required.reason: This slice accepts representable integral milliseconds with ms, s, m or h units, not bare numbers, strings, zero, negative values or cron expressions.
syntax.job_duration_required.recommendedNextStep: Use a supported positive duration such as `15m`
syntax.job_duration_required.summary: Job interval must be a positive finite duration

syntax.job_every_required.reason: A scheduled job uses `job name every duration` before its closed body.

syntax.job_export_invalid.reason: A job is an application schedule entry, not a callable or public module value.
syntax.job_export_invalid.recommendedNextStep: Remove public from the job declaration

syntax.job_item_duplicate.reason: Every job body declares concurrency, run and retry exactly once; a later value cannot replace an earlier clause.

syntax.job_item_unknown.reason: A job body accepts concurrency:, run:, retry: and an optional closed delivery: reminder_v1 descriptor. Delivery analysis remains unsupported; principal, intent, fences, outcomes and receipts remain compiler-owned.

syntax.job_run_invocation_required.reason: A job run binds a checked action with explicit argument mapping, not a bare name or inline body.
syntax.job_run_invocation_required.recommendedNextStep: Write `run: action_name(JobRunAt(clock.now))` with the action's exact nominal snapshot type
syntax.job_run_invocation_required.summary: Job run requires an action invocation

syntax.lifecycle_duplicate.reason: An entity has one lifecycle contract so initial state, visibility, transitions, and retention share a single source of truth.
syntax.lifecycle_duplicate.recommendedNextStep: Combine the lifecycle settings into one block
syntax.lifecycle_duplicate.summary: Entity declares lifecycle rules more than once

syntax.lifecycle_initial_duplicate.reason: The entity lifecycle has one initial field map; multiple blocks could disagree about compiler-owned creation state.
syntax.lifecycle_initial_duplicate.recommendedNextStep: Keep one `initial` block containing every lifecycle-owned field
syntax.lifecycle_initial_duplicate.summary: Lifecycle initial state is declared more than once

syntax.lifecycle_non_entity.reason: Lifecycle visibility and transitions are enforced against authoritative stored rows, so transient input and value records cannot own them.
syntax.lifecycle_non_entity.recommendedNextStep: Move this lifecycle block to a persistent entity

syntax.lifecycle_purge_after_required.reason: Retention is expressed as a minimum duration after the lifecycle timestamp, using the fixed `purge after ... from ...` form.

syntax.lifecycle_purge_duplicate.reason: One retention rule determines the bounded physical-removal authority for an entity.
syntax.lifecycle_purge_duplicate.summary: Entity declares more than one lifecycle purge

syntax.lifecycle_purge_from_required.reason: Retention must identify the lifecycle timestamp field that anchors eligibility.
syntax.lifecycle_purge_from_required.recommendedNextStep: Add `from timestamp_field` after the retention duration

syntax.lifecycle_setting_invalid.reason: Lifecycle blocks accept only initial state, visibility, named transitions, and an optional retention purge clause.
syntax.lifecycle_setting_invalid.recommendedNextStep: Replace this item with a supported lifecycle setting
syntax.lifecycle_setting_invalid.summary: Lifecycle block contains an unsupported setting

syntax.lifecycle_transition_duplicate.reason: A transition has one source predicate and one fixed assignment map, and transition names identify exactly one state change.
syntax.lifecycle_transition_duplicate.recommendedNextStep: Keep one `from`, one `set`, and one declaration for this transition name
syntax.lifecycle_transition_duplicate.summary: Lifecycle transition setting or name is repeated

syntax.lifecycle_transition_from_require.reason: The transition guard limits which current rows may enter its fixed state change.
syntax.lifecycle_transition_from_require.summary: Lifecycle transition requires a source predicate

syntax.lifecycle_transition_set_required.reason: The compiler must know the complete state change before an action invokes a named transition.
syntax.lifecycle_transition_set_required.recommendedNextStep: Add `set: { field: value }` to the transition

syntax.lifecycle_transition_setting_inva.reason: A transition declares only its current-state `from` predicate and compiler-owned `set` values.
syntax.lifecycle_transition_setting_inva.summary: Lifecycle transition contains an unsupported setting

syntax.lifecycle_visible_duplicate.reason: One visibility predicate must govern reads and mutations consistently for every ordinary caller.
syntax.lifecycle_visible_duplicate.summary: Lifecycle visibility is declared more than once

syntax.lifecycle_visible_when_required.reason: Visibility is a same-row predicate and uses the explicit `visible when predicate` form.

syntax.locales_default_required.reason: Formatting fallback must be deterministic, so every locale set names one supported default BCP 47 locale.
syntax.locales_default_required.summary: Locale declaration requires one default locale

syntax.locales_supported_required.reason: The generated `Locale` enum is closed over an explicit list rather than accepting host locale strings.
syntax.locales_supported_required.summary: Locale declaration requires a supported locale list

syntax.locales_unsupported_invalid.reason: Only rejection or deterministic fallback to the declared default has defined behavior.

syntax.locales_unsupported_required.reason: An application must decide whether an unsupported requested locale rejects or uses its declared default.
syntax.locales_unsupported_required.summary: Locale declaration requires an unsupported-locale policy

syntax.match_pattern.reason: A match arm must use a pattern supported by the matched value, such as a variant, Boolean, nullable pattern, or wildcard.
syntax.match_pattern.recommendedNextStep: Replace this source with a supported match pattern

syntax.mutation_conflict_required.reason: Required create, update, and delete operations must map storage conflicts into an authored domain failure rather than exposing adapter errors.
syntax.mutation_conflict_required.recommendedNextStep: Add at least one `conflict:` failure binding
syntax.mutation_conflict_required.summary: Mutation requires a conflict failure binding

syntax.named_argument_duplicate.reason: Each named argument identifies one parameter or option. Repeating a name would make the selected value ambiguous.
syntax.named_argument_duplicate.recommendedNextStep: Keep one value for this named argument

syntax.positional_after_named.reason: Calls put positional values first and policy or option values after them by name. Mixing the order makes signatures harder to read and evolve safely.
syntax.positional_after_named.recommendedNextStep: Move positional arguments before every named argument
syntax.positional_after_named.summary: Positional argument follows a named argument

syntax.query_page_after_required.reason: A page query must state how an optional continuation cursor is applied so the generated lookup never silently switches to offset pagination.
syntax.query_page_after_required.recommendedNextStep: Add `after: optional cursor_value` before the page limit
syntax.query_page_after_required.summary: Page query requires an explicit cursor boundary

syntax.query_page_cursor_required.reason: The continuation token needs a named value shape and explicit ordered fields so the compiler can validate its keyset predicate.
syntax.query_page_cursor_required.summary: Page query requires a typed cursor shape

syntax.query_page_predicate_operator.reason: Page predicates support equality, optional equality filters and optional less-than-or-equal filters with statically bound values.

syntax.query_page_project_required.reason: A bounded page must declare the output projection that the compiler selects and validates.
syntax.query_page_project_required.recommendedNextStep: Add `project: OutputShape` before the cursor declaration
syntax.query_page_project_required.summary: Page query requires a named projection

syntax.route_export_invalid.reason: Routes already define an external transport boundary. Module `public` exports apply to named declarations and cannot export an unnamed route.

syntax.type_parent_required.reason: A type definition builds on an existing type, such as `Text`, `Uuid`, or another named type.
syntax.type_parent_required.recommendedNextStep: Add the type it builds on after `=`
syntax.type_parent_required.summary: Refined type requires a parent type

syntax.unexpected_character.reason: This character is not part of any Jadpo name, value, keyword, or punctuation.
syntax.unexpected_character.recommendedNextStep: Remove the character or replace it with valid Jadpo syntax
syntax.unexpected_character.summary: Character is not valid Jadpo syntax

syntax.unexpected_token.reason: Found `{found}` while parsing this construct. Jadpo requires {expected} at this location, so parsing stops rather than guessing the authored structure.

syntax.unsupported_throw.reason: Jadpo failures are declared, typed, and propagated through `reject` and `attempt`; arbitrary exceptions would escape that checked boundary.
syntax.unsupported_throw.recommendedNextStep: Replace `throw` with a declared failure and `reject`

syntax.unterminated_string.reason: The lexer reached the line or file boundary before finding the quote that ends this string literal.
syntax.unterminated_string.recommendedNextStep: Add the closing quote, or remove the opening quote

test.failed.reason: The generated test process exited unsuccessfully; its report identifies the failing test or startup error.
test.failed.recommendedNextStep: Inspect the test report, correct the failure, and run `jadpo test` again

test.no_tests.reason: The project builds, but it declares no tests for the test command to execute.
test.no_tests.recommendedNextStep: Add a test declaration and run `jadpo test` again

test.runtime_start_failed.reason: Jadpo built the tests but could not launch the Bun executable.
test.runtime_start_failed.recommendedNextStep: Make Bun available on PATH and run `jadpo test` again

toolchain.artifact_cleanup_failed.reason: The new artifact set was promoted successfully, but cleanup of the temporary backup directory failed.
toolchain.artifact_cleanup_failed.recommendedNextStep: Inspect permissions on the project build directories and remove the stale backup safely
toolchain.artifact_cleanup_failed.summary: Previous build backup could not be removed

toolchain.artifact_promote_failed.reason: The compiler generated a complete staging directory but could not atomically replace the project build output; the previous complete output was preserved when possible.
toolchain.artifact_promote_failed.recommendedNextStep: Restore write and rename access to the project directory, then build again
toolchain.artifact_promote_failed.summary: Staged build artifacts could not be promoted

toolchain.artifact_stage_failed.reason: Artifact generation writes to a project-local staging directory before promotion so an incomplete build never replaces the last complete output.
toolchain.artifact_stage_failed.recommendedNextStep: Make the project directory writable and build again
toolchain.artifact_stage_failed.summary: Build staging directory could not be created

toolchain.artifact_write_failed.reason: The compiler could not create a directory or file inside its isolated build staging area, so the staged output was discarded.
toolchain.artifact_write_failed.recommendedNextStep: Check available space and project-directory permissions, then build again
toolchain.artifact_write_failed.summary: Generated artifact could not be written

toolchain.empty_project.reason: Jadpo source files were found and parsed without syntax errors, but none declares a type, enum, record, failure, callable, test, or route to compile.
toolchain.empty_project.recommendedNextStep: Add at least one top-level Jadpo declaration

toolchain.no_sources.reason: Source discovery found no files ending in `.jadpo` beneath the requested project path, excluding generated build output.
toolchain.no_sources.recommendedNextStep: Add a `.jadpo` source file or select the correct project path
toolchain.no_sources.summary: Project contains no Jadpo source files

toolchain.project_not_found.reason: The requested file or directory was not present when Jadpo began source discovery.
toolchain.project_not_found.recommendedNextStep: Correct the project path or create the project first

toolchain.project_read_failed.reason: Source discovery could not enumerate part of the project tree, so it cannot know which Jadpo files belong to the build.
toolchain.project_read_failed.recommendedNextStep: Restore directory read access and try again
toolchain.project_read_failed.summary: Project directory could not be read

toolchain.scaffold_destination_exists.reason: A new Jadpo project needs a directory destination; the selected path already belongs to a non-directory filesystem entry.
toolchain.scaffold_destination_exists.recommendedNextStep: Choose a new directory path for the project
toolchain.scaffold_destination_exists.summary: Scaffold destination is an existing file

toolchain.scaffold_destination_not_empty.reason: Project creation refuses to overwrite or mix generated starter files with existing directory contents.
toolchain.scaffold_destination_not_empty.recommendedNextStep: Choose an empty directory or a new destination
toolchain.scaffold_destination_not_empty.summary: Scaffold destination directory is not empty

toolchain.scaffold_name_invalid.reason: The scaffold manifest derives its project name from the final destination path component, which is missing or not valid text.
toolchain.scaffold_name_invalid.recommendedNextStep: Choose a destination path with a valid final directory name
toolchain.scaffold_name_invalid.summary: Project destination has no valid name

toolchain.scaffold_read_failed.reason: The project creator could not read the destination directory to prove that writing starter files would not overwrite existing content.
toolchain.scaffold_read_failed.recommendedNextStep: Restore read access or choose another destination
toolchain.scaffold_read_failed.summary: Scaffold destination could not be inspected

toolchain.scaffold_write_failed.reason: The project creator could not create one of the required starter directories or files.
toolchain.scaffold_write_failed.recommendedNextStep: Restore write access and available space, then create the project again
toolchain.scaffold_write_failed.summary: Project scaffold file could not be written

toolchain.source_read_failed.reason: Source discovery found the file, but its text became unavailable before parsing and checking could begin.
toolchain.source_read_failed.recommendedNextStep: Restore read access to the source file and retry
toolchain.source_read_failed.summary: Jadpo source file could not be read

toolchain.target_auth_not_implemented.reason: The application's selected authentication adapters, configuration or principal mapping are not fully supported by the generated runtime for `{route}`. Generation stops rather than weakening access control.
toolchain.target_auth_not_implemented.recommendedNextStep: Choose and implement the authentication boundary
toolchain.target_auth_not_implemented.summary: Protected route `{route}` cannot be generated yet

toolchain.target_dependency_manifest.reason: Jadpo's generated runtime must remain self-contained and may not emit package manifests, lockfiles, or vendored dependency directories.
toolchain.target_dependency_manifest.recommendedNextStep: Remove the generated dependency artifact from the target generator
toolchain.target_dependency_manifest.summary: Generated target attempted to add a dependency manifest

toolchain.target_durable_workflow_not_im.reason: The compiler can check and audit the accepted durable-workflow disposition, but persisted step state, compensation, reconciliation, and operator intervention still require their parked runtime contract.
toolchain.target_durable_workflow_not_im.summary: Durable workflow target execution is not implemented

toolchain.target_external_module.reason: Generated TypeScript may use the Bun runtime and compiler-emitted relative modules only; undeclared external packages would make the output non-hermetic.
toolchain.target_external_module.recommendedNextStep: Replace the import with supported runtime functionality or a generated relative module
toolchain.target_external_module.summary: Generated target imports an external module

toolchain.target_job_not_implemented.reason: The frontend checks this schedule, but a reviewed finite execution profile, durable failure dispositions and checked worker lowering are not implemented. Build stops rather than emitting a no-op or startup call.
toolchain.target_job_not_implemented.recommendedNextStep: Retain the checked schedule while completing its worker binding and execution gates

toolchain.target_liveness_not_local.reason: GET /health/live must remain public and local before readiness or authentication. This target supports only an input-free inline return of an output record containing literals or declared enum constants.
toolchain.target_liveness_not_local.recommendedNextStep: Choose a dependency-free public liveness response
toolchain.target_liveness_not_local.summary: Authored liveness route is not dependency-free

toolchain.target_store_not_implemented.reason: The current executable target supports the `primary` PostgreSQL or SQLite authority domain; physical adapters for other named authority stores remain parked.
toolchain.target_store_not_implemented.recommendedNextStep: Resolve the named authority-store adapter contract
toolchain.target_store_not_implemented.summary: Authority store target adapter is not implemented

type.argument_count.reason: A function or action invocation must supply exactly one value for each declared parameter in declaration order.
type.argument_count.recommendedNextStep: Add or remove arguments to match the function or action parameters
type.argument_count.summary: Call has the wrong number of arguments

type.arithmetic_operand.reason: Operators such as `+`, `-`, `*`, and `/` accept compatible numeric values, not text, Boolean values, records, or unrelated named types.
type.arithmetic_operand.recommendedNextStep: Use numbers on both sides, or choose an operation supported by these values

type.assign_immutable.reason: Parameters and ordinary `var` bindings are immutable. Only a local explicitly declared with `var mut` may receive a new value.
type.assign_immutable.recommendedNextStep: Declare a mutable local when rebinding is intended, or create a new value

type.assign_unknown.reason: Reassignment must target a visible local binding; declarations, fields, and unknown names cannot be assigned as locals.
type.assign_unknown.recommendedNextStep: Correct the local name or declare it before assigning

type.auth_adapter_setting.reason: First-party validators accept unique secret, previous_secret, audience and origin settings. Keys reference secret textual configuration. JWT validators accept only non-secret issuer, audience and jwks_uri text or URL settings. Service API keys may bind owner to a required persistent entity reference on their authority.
type.auth_adapter_setting.recommendedNextStep: Use the settings belonging to the selected validator and explicit configuration or authority references

type.auth_authority_not_persistent.reason: Authentication resolution must query an authoritative stored entity. A transient value or non-persistent entity cannot prove current identity or lifecycle state.
type.auth_authority_not_persistent.recommendedNextStep: Resolve the principal through a persistent authority entity
type.auth_authority_not_persistent.summary: Principal authority is not a persistent entity

type.auth_authority_not_unique.reason: An authentication identity must resolve to at most one authoritative entity row; a non-key field could construct ambiguous principals.
type.auth_authority_not_unique.recommendedNextStep: Resolve through an identity or unique entity field
type.auth_authority_not_unique.summary: Principal resolution authority is not unique

type.auth_claim_authoritative_field.reason: Credential claims may carry authentication facts such as subject or authentication strength, but application identity fields come from authoritative resolution.
type.auth_claim_authoritative_field.recommendedNextStep: Populate this principal field from an authority entity resolution
type.auth_claim_authoritative_field.summary: Credential claim cannot populate an authoritative principal field

type.auth_claim_unknown.reason: Provider and credential data is untrusted. Only the compiler-owned subject and authentication-strength claims may enter the intermediate identity contract.
type.auth_claim_unknown.recommendedNextStep: Map an allowlisted claim or obtain the field from authority resolution
type.auth_claim_unknown.summary: Authentication claim is not in the constrained identity schema

type.auth_exchange_binding.reason: The exchange endpoint uses one bearer strategy with a declared service API-key authority and a service signed validator. A user validator or a validator from another strategy cannot supply either role.
type.auth_exchange_binding.recommendedNextStep: Name the checked service key and signed validators in this bearer strategy
type.auth_exchange_binding.summary: Exchange must bind a service key and service signed validator

type.auth_exchange_path.reason: A compiler-owned exchange endpoint needs a nonempty absolute path of ASCII letters, digits, hyphens and underscores without parameters, query, fragment or escapes so its transport and artifact inventory are unambiguous.
type.auth_exchange_path.recommendedNextStep: Use a fixed path such as `/auth/exchange`
type.auth_exchange_path.summary: Exchange path must be a fixed absolute path

type.auth_exchange_route_collision.reason: The compiler-owned exchange endpoint must own its POST path. An authored route at the same literal path or a matching path parameter would make dispatch ambiguous.
type.auth_exchange_route_collision.recommendedNextStep: Move the exchange endpoint or the overlapping POST route
type.auth_exchange_route_collision.summary: Exchange path overlaps an authored POST route

type.auth_inactive_failure_kind.reason: A valid credential for a disabled user or service is an explicit application rejection, not absence, conflict, or an internal fault.
type.auth_inactive_failure_kind.recommendedNextStep: Declare the inactive failure with `kind: NotPermitted` (403) or `kind: Rejected` (422) to match the application contract
type.auth_inactive_failure_kind.summary: Inactive-principal failure has the wrong category

type.auth_jwt_transport.reason: The compiler-owned external JWT adapter accepts only the reserved Authorization bearer credential slot. Cookie authentication requires a first-party adapter with the browser CSRF boundary.
type.auth_jwt_transport.recommendedNextStep: Configure JWT validation under the bearer strategy without changing protected route requirements

type.auth_lifecycle_active_field.reason: Authentication may inspect only the authority subject, identity and lifecycle-owned state of a hidden lifecycle entity.
type.auth_lifecycle_active_field.recommendedNextStep: Base the active check on lifecycle-owned state fields
type.auth_lifecycle_active_field.summary: Lifecycle authentication check reads a private field

type.auth_lifecycle_mapping_scope.reason: A lifecycle authority lookup may map its subject and identity values, but must not read unrelated business or private fields.
type.auth_lifecycle_mapping_scope.recommendedNextStep: Map the authority subject or an identity field
type.auth_lifecycle_mapping_scope.summary: Lifecycle authentication mapping reads an unrelated field

type.auth_mapping_mismatch.reason: Principal construction keeps separately declared types distinct; resolution cannot copy an incompatible authority value into a principal field.
type.auth_mapping_mismatch.recommendedNextStep: Map a compatible authoritative field to this principal field
type.auth_mapping_mismatch.summary: Authority field does not match the principal field type

type.auth_principal_failure_context.reason: Failure context may be logged or disclosed according to its classification. Carrying the principal object would risk exposing authentication identity or provenance.
type.auth_principal_failure_context.recommendedNextStep: Store only the specific non-secret identifier required by the failure
type.auth_principal_failure_context.summary: Principal values cannot enter failure context

type.auth_principal_input.reason: The authenticated principal is constructed by the compiler-owned credential and authority pipeline. Request bodies and paths cannot assert an identity.
type.auth_principal_input.recommendedNextStep: Remove the principal type from the route input
type.auth_principal_input.summary: A principal cannot come from request input

type.auth_principal_output.reason: A principal contains authentication identity and provenance owned by the security boundary. Public outputs must project an explicitly declared non-principal value.
type.auth_principal_output.recommendedNextStep: Return a reviewed output projection instead of the principal
type.auth_principal_output.summary: Principal values cannot cross an ordinary output boundary

type.auth_public_principal.reason: An `auth: none` route never creates a principal, so it cannot directly or transitively reach behavior that reads one.
type.auth_public_principal.recommendedNextStep: Keep the route authenticated or remove the principal-dependent behavior
type.auth_public_principal.summary: Public behavior requires an authenticated principal

type.auth_reserved_route_input.reason: Configured authentication cookies and authorization headers belong exclusively to the generated authentication boundary; accepting the same name as application input would create a second untrusted credential path.
type.auth_reserved_route_input.recommendedNextStep: Remove the reserved credential field from the route input
type.auth_reserved_route_input.summary: Credential transport cannot be ordinary route input

type.auth_resolution_incomplete.reason: A strategy must produce one complete closed principal variant rather than a partial identity with missing authoritative fields.
type.auth_resolution_incomplete.recommendedNextStep: Map every required principal field from a validated claim or authority field
type.auth_resolution_incomplete.summary: Principal resolution does not construct every required field

type.auth_resolution_required.reason: Every configured user or service validator needs one checked authority path so immediate and fresh-authority requests can resolve exactly one active principal.
type.auth_resolution_required.recommendedNextStep: Add one resolution for this principal variant
type.auth_resolution_required.summary: Authentication validator has no authority resolution

type.clock_context.reason: `clock.now` is an effect owned by actions and boundary operations. Pure functions and named queries stay deterministic by receiving an `Instant` parameter.
type.clock_context.recommendedNextStep: Move the clock read into an action, or pass an `Instant` into this callable
type.clock_context.summary: The operation clock is unavailable in this context

type.conflict_duplicate_binding.reason: Each named persistence constraint, and the optional fallback, may have only one conflict mapping so a database violation selects one domain failure.
type.conflict_duplicate_binding.recommendedNextStep: Keep one conflict mapping for this constraint
type.conflict_duplicate_binding.summary: Constraint failure is mapped more than once

type.conflict_unknown_constraint.reason: A specific conflict mapping must refer to a compiler-owned identity, unique, or named compound-unique constraint on the mutated entity.
type.conflict_unknown_constraint.recommendedNextStep: Use a declared persistence constraint from the target entity
type.conflict_unknown_constraint.summary: Conflict mapping names an unknown constraint

type.constructor_argument_count.reason: A named scalar type, such as `CustomerId(...)`, wraps one compatible value and then checks its constraints.
type.constructor_argument_count.recommendedNextStep: Pass exactly one value between the parentheses
type.constructor_argument_count.summary: Type constructor needs exactly one value

type.constructor_input.reason: The value between the parentheses must match the type after `=` in this type's definition.
type.constructor_input.recommendedNextStep: Pass a value that matches the type definition
type.constructor_input.summary: Type constructor received the wrong type of value

type.create_not_entity.reason: `create` stores an object type that has a `persist` declaration. Ordinary object, enum, failure, and scalar types have no storage contract.
type.create_not_entity.recommendedNextStep: Add an appropriate `persist` declaration, or use ordinary object construction

type.delete_not_entity.reason: `delete required` operates on rows for an object type with a `persist` declaration.

type.duplicate_variant_field.reason: A data-carrying enum variant has one exact payload record; duplicate field names would make construction and pattern binding ambiguous.
type.duplicate_variant_field.recommendedNextStep: Keep one declaration of the variant payload field
type.duplicate_variant_field.summary: Enum variant payload field is repeated

type.field_on_non_record.reason: Only an object, failure context, or enum payload has named fields that can be selected with `.`.
type.field_on_non_record.recommendedNextStep: Use an object value before `.`, or remove the field access

type.field_update_forbidden.reason: Identity, immutable, scope, membership, and direct role-binding fields have compiler-owned write rules so an update cannot move a record or manufacture authority.
type.field_update_forbidden.recommendedNextStep: Remove the field from the update or use a separately reviewed transfer operation when that capability is available
type.field_update_forbidden.summary: Field cannot be changed by an ordinary update

type.generated_field_assignment.reason: A lifecycle field has one owner: the compiler supplies the stable operation time on creation or semantic change, so authored code cannot override it.
type.generated_field_assignment.recommendedNextStep: Remove the generated field from this assignment

type.generated_field_context.reason: Lifecycle timestamps describe database creation and change events and therefore have no defined meaning on transient input, output, or value objects.
type.generated_field_context.recommendedNextStep: Move this field to a persistent entity or remove its generated block
type.generated_field_context.summary: Generated lifecycle role requires a persistent entity field

type.generated_field_input.reason: Copying a generated field through an input or patch would let callers choose a compiler-owned timestamp.
type.generated_field_input.recommendedNextStep: Remove the generated field from the input or patch type
type.generated_field_input.summary: Generated lifecycle field cannot be accepted from input

type.generated_field_type.reason: Creation and change timestamps are always present absolute timeline values. Nullable, optional, date-only, and resolved display values cannot represent that role.
type.generated_field_type.summary: Generated lifecycle field must be a required `Instant`

type.generated_identity_invalid.reason: A compiler-generated identity belongs only to the persistent entity's declared identity field, uses the UUID representation, and is always present.
type.generated_identity_invalid.recommendedNextStep: Mark the required UUID identity field as `generated: identity`, or supply the identity explicitly
type.generated_identity_invalid.summary: Generated identity must be a required UUID identity field

type.include_duplicate_relationship.reason: A to-many query result has one field per included relationship; repeating a relationship would make that output field and its loading plan ambiguous.
type.include_duplicate_relationship.recommendedNextStep: Keep one include for each relationship
type.include_duplicate_relationship.summary: Relationship is included more than once

type.include_mixed_cardinality.reason: The batched child-include form combines only `many` inverse relationships. Owning-parent and optional inverse loads use their dedicated single-include forms.
type.include_mixed_cardinality.recommendedNextStep: Use `many` for every include in this set or split out the single-related load
type.include_mixed_cardinality.summary: To-many include set contains a non-many relationship
